source: extracted from dossiers/e###.html Innate Technique Feats sections

e001.name: Double Up
e001.text: One Kaichi activation may create two drill-horn manifestations; pay and track each horn separately. Both persist under the normal Kaichi duration. Horns are not summoned creatures, do not require a summon command, and do not consume creature or manifestation capacity. When you take the Attack action, resolve each available horn attack as part of that action; this never grants a second action.

e001.name: Zero Friction
e001.text: Gain +2 AC only while Reiki’s movement increase is active. It does not stack with itself or remain during a turn in which the speed benefit is suppressed.

e001.name: Maximum: Kirin’s Flames
e001.text: While Kirin is active, each melee hit against you deals fire damage to its attacker equal to three times the HP you actually lost after reductions and temporary HP. This requires no reaction, cannot trigger from reflected damage, and cannot recursively trigger itself.

e002.name: All Seeing
e002.text: Seeing through a crow no longer blinds your body. You perceive from both locations, but a sight-based check uses one viewpoint chosen before rolling; physical cover and line of sight still apply from that viewpoint.

e002.name: Scavenger
e002.text: Once per turn after you damage a frightened creature with an attack, gain PB temporary HP. Temporary HP does not stack.

e002.name: Maximum: Kamikaze
e002.prereq: Prerequisite: Bird Strike and CE score 20
e002.text: For each Bird Strike choose one: replace its d10 base dice with d12s, or make it a limb-tagged attack without targeted-strike disadvantage and subtract 1d6 from the target’s injury save. It still must meet the revised injury threshold.

e003.name: Blood Production
e003.text: Bonus action, 1 CE: produce enough blood to replace up to 10 HP of one Blood Manipulation cost before the end of your next turn. Unused blood becomes inert and cannot be stockpiled.

e003.name: Poisonous Blood
e003.text: Once per turn, a creature hit by your blood attack with an attack total of 15+ or failing a save against your blood feature by 5+ becomes poisoned for 1 minute. It repeats a Constitution save against CE DC at the end of each turn.

e003.name: Blood Crystallization
e003.text: Bonus action, 3 CE, Technique Focus for 1 minute: resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing; unarmed die increases one size; reaction adds +5 AC against one attack. At each turn’s start roll d20; on 1–3 gain one exhaustion level. Ending the form requires no action.

e003.name: Flowing Red Scale: Stack
e003.text: While Flowing Red Scale is active, bonus action and 5 CE upgrades rather than stacks with it: triple base speed, +3 AC, advantage on Strength/Dexterity saves and Strength checks, one restricted extra action, and a second reaction each round. It shares the original duration and Technique Focus.

e003.name: Blood Edge
e003.text: Once on your turn with no action, spend 1–CE modifier CE and matching HP to form one proficient melee weapon for 1 minute. It is cursed; base damage is d10, rising one step per 2 CE to d12 then 2d8. A suitable outside blood source waives only the HP cost.

e003.name: Maximum: Supernova
e003.prereq: Prerequisite: Piercing Blood and CE score 20
e003.text: Action: create up to PB orbs in open spaces within 30 feet. Each costs 10 CE and 10 HP as Piercing Blood. An orb lasts 1 minute and detonates immediately or by your reaction: creatures within 10 feet make Dexterity saves, taking 10d8 piercing and prone on failure, half and no prone on success. Resolve overlapping orbs separately.

e003.name: Maximum: Wing King
e003.prereq: Prerequisite: Piercing Blood and CE score 20
e003.text: Bonus action, 10 CE, once per long rest: for 1 minute with Technique Focus, quadruple walking speed and gain flying speed equal to half that walking speed. Gain one restricted extra action that can make three ranged CE attacks, each dealing 3d10 + CE modifier necrotic on hit.

e004.name: Flawless Acting
e004.text: After seven days and $2,500 of expenses, establish one false identity with clothing, records, profession, and affiliations. It cannot duplicate a real person. Investigation contests your Deception to expose inconsistencies; the identity grants no legal authority the fiction cannot support.

e004.name: Memory Bank
e004.text: You perfectly remember everything you experience. As an action, touch an object and store any continuous portion of one remembered experience in it; there is no added object or duration cap. A creature touching it may use an action to begin experiencing the memory from your point of view at normal speed and may stop at will. A memory grants information, not proficiency, statistics, or technique access.

e004.name: Maximum: Backup
e004.text: Prepare an eligible humanoid corpse over 8 hours, then use an action and 10 CE to designate it as your only backup. On death, resolve the Clone spell’s soul-transfer procedure using that body, without its gold or maturation time. Preparing a new backup destroys the old link; a trapped or unwilling soul cannot transfer.

e005.name: Boogie Down
e005.text: After you use Boogie, the first attack against you before the start of your next turn has disadvantage. Multiple swaps do not add more protected attacks.

e005.name: Beguiling Tactics
e005.text: An unwilling creature swapped by Woogie makes an Intelligence save; failure stuns it until the start of its next turn. After its first success it has advantage on later saves that encounter. As an action, fake-clap with Performance or Deception contested by Insight; on a win it has disadvantage on its next Beguiling save before end of your next turn.

e005.name: Maximum: Best Friend
e005.prereq: Prerequisite: Round of Applause and CE score 20
e005.text: At initiative choose one willing ally. Swapping that ally costs 0 CE. Its first attack after being swapped from an enemy’s reach expands critical range by 3. While you flank together, each of you adds PB damage to attacks and ends when combat does.

e006.name: Subtle Constructs
e006.text: After creating an item, make Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) against each observer’s passive Perception. Against a creature you fool, your first attack or check using that item before end of next turn has advantage. The creation itself remains subject to line of sight and obvious physical evidence.

e006.name: Imbue
e006.text: When using Cursed Creation to construct a cursed tool, pay twice that tool’s normal CE cost to imbue the creation with the tool’s Technique for 7 days. There is no added one-item cap. The created tool uses the normal attunement rules and your CE attack/DC when its technique needs them; Creating a Special Grade tool still kills the creator afterward and cannot be reversed or revived.

e006.name: Maximum: Perfect Sphere
e006.prereq: Prerequisite: Insectoid Armor and CE score 20
e006.text: Action, 10 CE: create one 5-foot-radius sphere within 10 feet for 1 minute with Technique Focus. It is indestructible while maintained. Ending a turn adjacent or being rammed forces one Dexterity save per turn for 5d12 force, half on success. Bonus action moves it 30 feet; it destroys barriers and unattended nonmagical structures in its path.

e007.name: Detonate
e007.text: When activating Granite Blast, you may make it a melee CE attack with 5-foot reach instead of a ranged attack. All cost, damage, and other modifiers remain unchanged.

e007.name: Canshot
e007.text: Corrected prerequisite: Grape Shot. Once per Granite Blast activation after one blast hits, spend 3 CE; every other creature within 5 feet of that target takes half the damage actually dealt, with no additional attack or save. The original target is not hit twice.

e007.name: Maximum: Antimatter Bomb
e007.text: When you activate Nuclear Shell, its cone may become a 100-foot-radius sphere centered on you. You are excluded; all other creatures save normally. Unattended nonmagical objects and structures in the sphere are reduced to dust. Pay Nuclear Shell’s normal cost and charge time.

e008.name: Fighting Words
e008.text: When a creature fails a save against your cursed word, it makes a second Wisdom save. On failure, for 1 minute it has disadvantage on attacks that do not include you as a target; it repeats the save at the end of each turn. A creature can be affected by only one Fighting Words at a time.

e008.name: Quick Tongue
e008.text: Choose one additional cursed word you know. That word may be used with Interjection. Change the choice only when gaining a level.

e008.name: Megaphone
e008.text: When using Resounding Voice, spend 3 additional CE to replace its area with a 70-foot cone. This replaces rather than adds to its range; all vocal-cord, target, and save rules remain.

e009.name: Cursed Spirit Embodiment
e009.prereq: Prerequisite: Cursed Spirit Absorption and CE score 16+
e009.text: Action; spend CE equal to the absorbed spirit’s CR, rounded up (minimum 1), and transform for up to half your character level in hours. Replace your Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, AC, current HP, movement, senses, and creature actions with the spirit’s profile; retain your Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, personality, alignment, and any proficiency bonus that is higher. You cannot use Cursed Spirit Manipulation features or legendary, lair, or mythic actions while transformed. At 0 spirit HP you revert, and excess damage carries over to your original HP.

e009.name: Defensive Summoning
e009.text: Reaction when hit, before damage: spend 5 CE plus the chosen stored spirit’s summon cost and manifest it in an adjacent legal space. It becomes the attack’s target; compare the original attack roll with its AC and apply damage to it. Area effects still affect every creature normally.

e009.name: Uzumaki Versatility
e009.prereq: Prerequisite: Maximum: Uzumaki and CE score 20
e009.text: Bonus action: permanently consume exactly two stored spirits to form a miniature Uzumaki for 1 minute. Action or reaction when a target comes within 60 feet, 5 CE: ranged CE attack; hit deals Xd12 necrotic, X = combined CR rounded up. Ignore resistance, treat immunity as resistance. Undetected target grants advantage. Extract one action using the revised Uzumaki rules.

e010.name: Tool Versatility
e010.text: As a bonus action, reshape the gavel into any melee weapon. You are proficient with it and it uses that weapon’s damage and properties; no ammunition, consumable, or attached special-grade property is created. It returns to gavel form when released.

e010.name: Weight of Judgment
e010.text: Once per turn after a gavel hit, spend 2 CE to roll one additional set of the weapon’s base damage dice. The target also makes a Strength save, falling prone on failure. The added dice are not doubled by another amplifier.

e010.name: Judgeman Release
e010.text: Bonus action, 5 CE, Technique Focus for 1 minute: summon intangible Judgeman and designate one perceived opponent within 60 feet. Every time that opponent attacks, its cumulative assault penalty increases by 1. Subtract the full penalty from its attack rolls and saving throws until Judgeman leaves; there is no added charge cap.

e011.name: Pyrokinesis
e011.text: Repeatable; choose a different option each time: fire resistance, or two fire-damaging spells of level 1–4. Cast chosen spells with CE ability and CE equal to spell level; cantrips, if allowed, cost 1 CE. No spell may be selected twice.

e011.name: Shooting Star
e011.text: Bonus action, spend 1–PB CE to gain a 60-foot flying speed for that many rounds. The flight ends if incapacitated; if it ends aloft, normal falling rules apply.

e011.name: Hellscape
e011.text: Action, 15 CE, Technique Focus for 1 minute: unattended nonmagical objects and ground in a 100-foot radius melt into lava. It is difficult terrain; entering or ending a turn there causes a Constitution save, 4d6 fire on failure, half on success, once per turn. Bonus action moves one 10-foot lava square up to 20 feet along a surface.

e012.name: Hydrokinesis
e012.text: Repeatable; choose differently each time. Piercing Water: action, 2 CE, ranged CE attack at 30 feet; hit deals 2d10 cold + 2d6 piercing, then Constitution save. Failure knocks prone and repeats that rolled damage once. Or learn two level 1–4 water spells at CE equal to spell level.

e012.name: Shoal
e012.text: You may activate Death Swarm outside the Domain with its normal action, target, summon capacity, and any listed CE cost. It has no sure-hit; attacks and saves resolve normally.

e012.name: Typhoon
e012.text: For 4 additional CE, the Ring creates the printed 20-foot storm for the Ring’s duration. A creature saves once when the storm appears and whenever it ends a turn there, taking 2d6 bludgeoning on failure. Bonus action each turn makes the 60-foot 4d6 lightning attack. The area moves with you and is difficult terrain.

e013.name: Chlorokinesis
e013.text: Repeatable; choose a different option: bonus action transforms one active root wall into another wall option without refreshing HP/duration, or learn two level 1–4 nature spells, cast with CE ability for CE equal to spell level. No spell may be selected twice.

e013.name: Bouquet
e013.text: Action, 3 CE: one creature within 60 feet makes the normal Flower Field save and suffers its effects for the normal duration. It does not create an area and cannot affect additional creatures through movement.

e013.name: Sapping Roots
e013.text: Action, 5 CE, Technique Focus for 1 minute. Once per turn after a melee or innate-technique attack deals damage, regain 1d4 CE. The activation can restore at most PB CE total and never above maximum; then it ends. This closes the self-funding attack loop without removing the drain fantasy.

e014.name: Black Belt
e014.text: Repeatable; choose each maneuver once. Takedown uses a bonus-action grapple after a melee hit. Judo Throw triggers on a hit against your grappled Huge-or-smaller target: Strength save, prone on failure and stunned to end of next turn if failed by 5+. Flying Drop Kick uses an action and your jump movement for one unarmed attack, pushing 30 feet on hit.

e014.name: Opportunistic Blow
e014.text: Once per turn after the delayed Divergent Fist damage lands, the target makes an Intelligence save. On failure, attacks against it have advantage until the start of your next turn.

e014.name: Maximum: Soul Punch
e014.prereq: Prerequisite: Chosen by the Sparks and CE score 20
e014.text: Before an unarmed attack, spend 5 CE; all your unarmed hits this turn deal soul damage that ordinary RCT cannot heal. Each hit gives one Output Suppression, maximum CE modifier: reduce optional CE spending ceiling by 1 per stack and disable Maximum Output while any stack remains. All stacks end after a short or long rest.

e015.name: Lover’s Embrace
e015.text: A successful shove originating from a Love Hand pushes 10 feet instead of 5. A creature grappled or restrained by your Hand takes 1d6 necrotic at the start of each of its turns, once regardless of the number of Hands.

e015.name: Handy Dandy
e015.text: Action, 2 CE: lock one active Hand into a solid 10-by-10-foot platform for up to 10 minutes. It supports up to 2,000 pounds and uses the Hand’s AC/HP. The locked Hand cannot attack, grapple, shove, or shield; bonus action releases it.

e015.name: Maximum: Love at First Sight
e015.prereq: Prerequisite: Cutie Honey and CE score 20
e015.text: Action, 10 CE: one creature within an active Hand’s reach makes the Cutie Honey Wisdom save. On failure it suffers that feature’s full 1-minute effect and repeating save without requiring a hit or restraint first.

e016.name: Iceshape
e016.text: Action, 1 CE: form one simple or martial melee weapon from ice in your reach. You are proficient with it, it counts as cursed, and it lasts 1 hour. It has AC 13 and HP equal to 5 + level, melts harmlessly when destroyed, and grants no copied item property.

e016.name: Frostbite
e016.text: Whenever a creature becomes restrained by your ice, it gains one exhaustion level. The same uninterrupted restraint applies this only once, but a later new restraint can add another level; there is no added Frostbite ceiling.

e016.name: Maximum: Shatter
e016.text: Action: choose a creature restrained by your ice; it makes a Constitution save. Failure breaks one chosen limb and ends the restraint. It severs instead only if the restraint or same activation meets the revised Sever threshold, or the target is at or below 25% maximum HP. Success ends the restraint without injury.

e017.name: Remote Transfiguration
e017.text: A deliberate bare-hand touch may place one detectable soul mark on a Humanoid indefinitely. While on the same plane and knowing its identity, use an action and pay the normal Transfiguration cost to affect it at any distance; it saves normally. The mark is consumed after the attempt and can be removed by Technique Extermination or explicit soul repair.

e017.name: Awakening
e017.text: When altering a willing Non-Sorcerer, make one DC 15 CE ability check per creature. Success and 10 CE awaken a latent, lore-consistent innate technique after 1d4+1 days. The GM records the technique; it uses the target’s character level and does not grant class features or a second technique. The permanent change can reshape a campaign.

e017.name: Maximum: Spirit Body of Distorted Killing
e017.prereq: Prerequisite: Self-Embodiment of Perfection and CE score 20
e017.text: Action, 10 CE: for 10 minutes your AC cannot be below 25 and you gain proficient elbow blades (1d12 + CE modifier piercing). On each blade attack, spend 1 CE for advantage and 15-foot reach. The form ends if incapacitated; AC bonuses do not raise the 25-floor unless they normally stack.

e018.name: Offensive Infinity
e018.text: Action, spend 1–PB CE: choose a creature within 15 feet and within 10 feet of a solid surface. Constitution save; failure takes Xd6 force and is restrained against that surface until start of your next turn, success takes half and is not restrained. X equals CE spent.

e018.name: Spatial Skirmishing
e018.text: Once per turn when making an unarmed strike, pay Blue’s normal cost and use CE ability for the attack; on hit apply Blue and gain advantage on that attack. After learning Red, choose Red instead: on hit the target makes the normal Strength save and is launched as Red states. One strike cannot carry both.

e018.name: Teleportation
e018.text: Action, spend 1–PB CE: teleport yourself to an open space you can see, 10 feet per CE. You may carry worn/held equipment and one willing creature no larger than you if you spend 1 additional CE within the same PB cap.

e018.name: Delayed Purple
e018.text: While one of your Blues persists within 120 feet, activate Red into it as an action, or as a reaction when a creature enters or ends a turn in the Blue. Pay both Red and Hollow Purple costs. Every creature—including you—in a 100-foot radius makes a Dexterity save; failure takes the maximum value of Hollow Purple’s 20d12 base dice (240 force damage), success half. Riders and amplifier dice are rolled normally.

e019.name: Comet Reactions
e019.text: Whenever you spend one of Effective Marking's additional reactions, you may pay 1 CE to use it for any ordinary reaction trigger instead of marking. You still need a legal trigger; the CE-modifier reaction pool is preserved.

e019.name: Repelling Forces
e019.text: Bonus action, spend 3–PB CE: every marked creature is forced directly away from the marked body with the greatest current CE, 10 feet per CE spent. This is simultaneous forced movement, causes no opportunity attacks, and stops at solid obstacles.

e019.name: Maximum: Star Crossed
e019.prereq: Prerequisite: Shining Star and CE score 20
e019.text: Action, 10 CE: choose a creature within 120 feet carrying all five marks. The marks collapse into it; Constitution save, taking 25d4 force on failure or half on success. All five marks are consumed. cannot be multiplied.

e020.name: Defensive Surge
e020.text: Reaction when a melee attack hits you: the attacker makes a Constitution save. On failure it is paralyzed until the start of its next turn. This does not cancel the triggering hit and can affect a creature only once per turn.

e020.name: Imbued Weapon
e020.text: Each melee weapon hit may place one positive charge in that weapon, maximum twice CE modifier for one weapon. Bonus action while it is within 60 feet: consume all charges to create a 5-foot-wide line between you and it. Creatures in the line make Dexterity saves, taking 1d12 lightning per charge, half on success.

e020.name: Grounded Charge
e020.prereq: Prerequisite: CE score 20 and Mythical Beast Amber Release
e020.text: Corrected prerequisite: CE score 20, not above 20. During Release, treat elapsed time as one minute lower for every side effect. The minute-5 collapse therefore occurs at minute 6. This does not restore the once-ever activation or prevent death after the extended limit.

e021.name: Augmented Vow
e021.prereq: Prerequisite: True New Shadow Style: Simple Domain
e021.text: When opening Simple Domain, state one symmetrical conduct rule and one consequence no harsher than 5d10 damage or one condition until end of the breaker’s next turn. Every creature inside, including you, knows it and is bound for CE modifier rounds or until leaving. It cannot compel impossible actions, surrender, self-harm, or permanent loss.

e021.name: Instantaneous Attack
e021.text: While your Simple Domain is active, use an action to prepare. The next time a hostile creature enters your weapon reach before the Domain ends, use your reaction to make one weapon attack. The preparation is then consumed.

e021.name: First Strike
e021.text: Once when initiative is rolled, with no action choose one: activate Simple Domain and pay its cost, or make one weapon attack against a creature already within reach. This occurs after initiative is set and before the first turn.

e022.name: Contagious Luck
e022.text: When using Great Luck, you may choose one willing creature within 30 feet instead of yourself. The use, duration, die, and any cost are unchanged; you do not also gain the benefit.

e022.name: Pachinko Manifest
e022.text: You may use the technique’s Pachinko Attacks outside the Domain at a 30-foot range. Use their normal actions, attack/DC, and CE costs; they gain no sure-hit, expectation modifier, jackpot roll, or Domain-only event unless an entry expressly grants it.

e022.name: Maximum: Love Train
e022.prereq: Prerequisite: The Fever and Pachinko Manifest
e022.text: Action, 10 CE: choose an origin within 30 feet and a 200-by-20-foot line. Creatures make Dexterity saves. Failure takes 15d6 bludgeoning, is carried to the line’s far end, and falls prone; success takes half and does not move. A solid obstacle stops movement but does not add damage.

e023.name: Fortissimo
e023.text: After a critical hit qualifies—or after Black Flash is confirmed—spend 3 CE to maximize the entire completed attack damage. It may combine with distinct effects; two maximization effects do not improve an already maximized roll.

e023.name: Cadence
e023.text: Reaction, 4 CE, after a creature affected by your Prayer rolls but before outcome: make its attack miss or turn its successful save into a failure. This cannot override Legendary Resistance, immunity, or a natural 20 attack.

e023.name: Maximum: Double Time
e023.text: Action, 10 CE: for 1 minute with Technique Focus, your Prayer track advances by two beats instead of one at the start of each turn. Other creatures do not gain extra turns and durations do not expire twice as fast.

e024.name: White Space
e024.text: Reaction when you take damage, 2 CE: roll 2d10 + CE modifier d10 and create a damage-absorption pool until the start of your next turn. Subtract incoming damage from the pool before HP; it can absorb multiple instances and any unused amount expires.

e024.name: Air Shatter
e024.text: Action, 5 CE: creatures in a 30-foot line make Dexterity saves, taking CE modifier d10 force on failure or half on success. Roll damage once.

e024.name: Maximum: Sakuga
e024.prereq: Prerequisite: Fastest Sorcerer Alive and CE score 20
e024.text: Bonus action, 1 CE; for up to 1 minute with Technique Focus pay 1 CE at each turn’s start. Speed doubles, Dexterity saves have advantage, and you gain one restricted extra action for one weapon attack, Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object. It stacks with distinct extra-action sources unless Sakuga itself is duplicated.

e025.name: Puppet Armor
e025.text: Action while adjacent to an active puppet: wear it and remove it from the active roster. Gain temporary HP equal to its current HP, +2 AC, its physical scores, movement, senses, and non-action traits. When temporary HP ends the armor is destroyed; action exits early with remaining puppet HP. It cannot act separately while worn.

e025.name: Communication Puppets
e025.text: After each long rest create up to PB Tiny messengers, each holding a snapshot of your consciousness and 5 minutes of activity. AC 15, 1 HP, speed 20; no attacks or technique. Set a perceivable trigger. While any are active on the same plane, memories they acquire synchronize with you and each other when the activity ends.

e025.name: Maximum: Ultimate Puppet
e025.text: Corrected prerequisite: Absolute Puppet. An Ultimate chassis has twice the normal trait allotment and requires twice the normal materials, construction time, and CE to create and summon. Repeated construction is permitted; no added one-chassis limit applies.

e026.name: Focused Attacks
e026.text: Your Ratio critical threshold improves by 1 again. This stacks with Critical Focus, producing its intended expanded range, but not with unrelated effects that merely replace rather than increase critical range.

e026.name: Weapon Breaker
e026.text: Reaction when targeted by a weapon attack, 3 CE: wielder makes Dexterity save. On failure a mundane weapon breaks before damage; a cursed tool breaks only if your striking tool is equal or higher grade, otherwise the attack is deflected and misses. Artifacts and unique Special Grades break only when their own story permits.

e026.name: Fatal Ratio
e026.text: Corrected prerequisite: Improved Ratio. After a Ratio critical, spend 2 CE to make it a limb-tagged hit without targeted-strike disadvantage. Resolve damage and the revised injury threshold/save normally; the feat does not automatically sever a limb.

e027.name: Spiderweb
e027.text: For 1 additional CE, replace Dismantle’s attack with a 30-foot cone. Creatures make Dexterity saves, taking the normal Dismantle damage on failure or half on success. Roll once for the area.

e027.name: Form of Battle
e027.text: While a creature is grappled by you, your attacks against it have advantage and it has disadvantage on saves against your features. Both benefits end immediately when the grapple ends.

e027.name: Maximum: World Cutter
e027.prereq: Prerequisite: Malevolent Shrine and CE score 20
e027.text: Action with an audible chant and free hand: pay Cleave/Dismantle’s cost +5 CE and make its attack. It cuts occupied space, ignores cover, barriers, technique-created AC, resistance, and immunity. Resolve against base armor/natural/unarmored AC. A miss still expends CE; it cannot combine with Chanting or Maximum Output.

e028.name: Cloak of Invisibility
e028.text: Action, 3 CE: cast Invisibility on yourself using Technique Focus, without needing spellcasting. If you have Sky Armor, its AC and flight remain active while invisible. Attacking or activating a hostile technique ends invisibility as the spell states.

e028.name: Spatial Tear
e028.text: Corrected feature name: Thin Ice Breaker. When activating it, spend 2 additional CE to replace the line and save with one melee CE attack. On hit, deal force damage equal to a number of d10s equal to your CE modifier and knock the target prone; on miss, no damage. It remains one activation.

e028.name: Maximum: Hurricane
e028.prereq: Prerequisite: Thin Ice Breaker and CE score 20
e028.text: Action, 10 CE: creatures of your choice within 30 feet make Strength saves. Failure launches a creature 1,000 feet upward; success leaves it in place. Flying, reactions, ceilings, and normal falling damage apply; a ceiling stops ascent at the available distance.

e029.name: Blessing of Resilience
e029.text: When Zone is established, allies inside gain 5 temporary HP; re-entering does not refresh it. While inside, once per turn each ally adds PB to one damage roll. ends immediately on leaving.

e029.name: Blessing of Combat
e029.text: Once per turn while inside your Zone, each ally may add 1d4 to one attack or damage roll after rolling but before outcome. The same roll cannot receive both this die and another Zone die.

e029.name: Maximum: Shrine of the Gods
e029.prereq: Prerequisite: Arena, Bless, and CE score 20
e029.text: Corrected prerequisite replaces Self-Embodiment of Perfection. Action, 10 CE: roll d10 and manifest Zone for that many rounds without its normal continuing action or Technique Focus requirement. Roll once; the duration cannot be refreshed or extended.

e030.name: Massive Push
e030.text: Once per turn when you score a critical hit while virtual mass is active, push the target 15 feet directly away. This is forced movement and causes no opportunity attack.

e030.name: Shooting Star
e030.text: Action, 5 CE while mass is active: kick one unsecured object within reach through a 50-by-5-foot line. Creatures make Dexterity saves, taking twice your base unarmed dice plus attack ability modifier bludgeoning on failure, half on success. A failed save also allows an injury check only if that single damage meets the revised threshold.

e030.name: Maximum: Black Hole
e030.text: Action, 20 CE: choose a radius up to 100 feet and irrevocably sacrifice yourself; your body becomes the singularity. Other creatures make Strength saves. Failure dies; success survives and is pulled 30 feet toward center. A creature immune to instant death instead takes 20d10 force on failure, half on success. Ordinary RCT or revival cannot restore you.

e031.name: Nail Volley
e031.text: Action: spend X CE and consume X nails, X from 1 to CE modifier. Create a cone 10 × X feet long. Creatures make Dexterity saves, taking Xd4 piercing on failure or half on success. All nails land in the area and may be recovered normally.

e031.name: 1000 Needles
e031.text: When planting Hairpin nails, pay 1 extra CE per nail. A creature failing any detonation save is restrained for 1 minute. At each turn’s end it chooses Athletics or Acrobatics against CE DC; success ends it, failure deals 1d8 piercing. Multiple nails do not stack the condition or damage.

e031.name: Maximum: Last Nail in the Coffin
e031.text: After a Resonance hit resolves, spend 10 CE to immediately apply Improved Resonance to that target without its normal condition prerequisite or additional action. Make its melee CE attack; on hit resolve its damage and suppression normally. This consumes the Resonance link.

e032.name: Blessed Blow
e032.text: Once per turn after an attack hits, spend 2–PB CE. Add 2d12 radiant for the first 2 CE and 1d12 for each further CE. The rider is not doubled by the critical hit.

e032.name: Archangel’s Present
e032.text: Choose any Blessing from the campaign’s Dungeon Master reference when the breakthrough occurs and record its complete rules. A custom Blessing of comparable scope is also valid with the GM.

e032.name: Sword of Michael
e032.prereq: Prerequisite: Maximum: Jacob’s Ladder and CE score 20
e032.text: Action: pay Jacob’s Ladder’s normal cost +5 CE and make one melee CE attack. On hit the creature alone suffers 10d12 radiant damage and the revised Jacob’s Ladder technique-nullification effect; on miss all CE is spent. It does not create the original area.

e033.name: Maximum: Crippling Strikes
e033.prereq: Prerequisite: Unblockable Blows and CE score 20
e033.text: Unblockable Blows normally spends 1 CE to ignore resistance or impose vulnerability when none exists. With this feat, spend 2 CE total against immunity to turn that immunity into resistance for the hit. It does not both reduce immunity and ignore the resulting resistance.

e033.name: Maximum: Blast Away
e033.prereq: Prerequisite: Energy Blast and CE score 20
e033.text: When Energy Blast spends at least 5 CE, its dice become d8s. On a hit, the target makes a Strength save or is pushed 10 feet. Spend the amount allowed by Energy Blast; there is no universal Output Rank or optional CE ceiling.

e033.name: Maximum: Fortress
e033.prereq: Prerequisite: Defensive Form and CE score 20
e033.text: Action, 3 CE while you have Defensive Form temporary HP: gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing until those temporary HP are gone, you leave the form, or 1 minute passes.

e034.name: Partial Manifestation Versatility
e034.text: Once per turn when Partial Manifestation would add damage, forgo all of that added damage to attempt one grapple or shove against the hit target as part of the attack, using your CE ability in place of Strength if desired.

e034.name: Technique Storage
e034.text: Double Mimicry’s technique capacity. Half the slots, rounded down, belong to the Vengeful Spirit and are unavailable while it is absent. While it is within 60 feet, use an action to exchange one technique in your active memory with one stored in the spirit.

e034.name: Free Spirit
e034.text: The spirit is no longer berserk and acts immediately after you. A bonus action gives a simple command; an action gives an autonomous objective it follows without further commands. It can manifest for one continuous minute per long rest, remains a Cursed Spirit for effects, and otherwise follows the technique’s summon profile.

e035.name: Divine Dog Totality
e035.prereq: Prerequisite: Divine Dogs tamed, and one Divine Dog has died (reduced to 0 HP).
e035.text: Manifest the surviving Dog as Divine Dog Totality. Totality is mutually exclusive with both original Dogs and uses the revised Totality stat block.

e035.name: Shadow Skulker
e035.text: As an action for 2 CE, submerge into your shadow for consecutive turns equal to your Constitution modifier, minimum one.

e035.name: Chimerafication
e035.prereq: Prerequisite: Wells Unknown Abyss and a 20 CE ability score.
e035.text: Build one base plus as many as three donor additions under the Chimerafication rules: living shikigami combine — no shadow is sacrificed and none need be dead. Three ready-to-play presets—Zagroth, Hageshi, and Agito—appear in the Fusion Catalog.

e035.name: Maximum: Embodiment
e035.text: Mahoraga: borrowing Mahoraga's Adaptation grants its Eight-Handled Wheel three-stage adaptation as described in this dossier's Mahoraga stat block (damage types, conditions, and obstacles each adapt through exposure → resistance → immunity or functional counter).

e036.name: Unbroken Combination
e036.text: Once on each of your turns when a qualifying attack misses, you may spend 1 CE without an action. That miss does not reset your Siphon Counter, though it does not advance it. The normal end-of-turn reset still occurs if you do not attempt another qualifying attack.

e036.name: Deep Draw
e036.text: Your Temporary CE cap becomes 5 × character level. Whenever Siphon triggers, you may spend 1 ordinary or Temporary CE to increase that activation’s maximum drain by half your PB, rounded up. You gain only the CE the target actually loses.

e036.name: Blood-Price Champion
e036.prereq: Prerequisite: Amphitheater of the Living Dead
e036.text: Once per round when one of your qualifying attacks removes Gladiator HP from a hostile competitor, add 1 CE to the Colosseum Pool after the damage resolves. If that attack was a critical hit, add your PB instead. This contribution does not drain either combatant and cannot itself change Favor until the Pool is recalculated.

e036.name: Curator of Spoils
e036.text: Before level 18, roll twice whenever you gain a random Spoil and choose either result. At level 18, an option that would roll once instead rolls twice and chooses one; an option that would roll twice and gain both instead rolls three times and gains any two. Duplicate results are rerolled until the offered results are distinct.

e037.name: Flywheel Counter
e037.text: When you take bludgeoning, piercing, slashing, force, or thunder damage, use your reaction and spend 2 CE. Roll PB Drive Dice and add CE modifier once, reducing the damage by the total. Gain 1 Gear per Drive Die, maximum Gear 10. If inactive, Kinetic Transmission activates at Gear 0 before these Gears are gained.

e037.name: Suspended Interval
e037.text: Creature: action and 5 CE; a marked creature within 60 feet makes a Constitution save or becomes restrained, immovable, and unable to react until the end of your next turn.

e037.name: Vector Skip
e037.text: When using Acceleration Shift, pay 1 additional CE. For every Gear lowered, teleport 20 feet instead of gaining 15 feet of speed. Bring one willing adjacent creature by lowering one additional Gear. Your first Impact Shift that turn adds one Drive Die.

e037.name: Relativistic Break
e037.text: While at Gear 10 during Redline, as a full-turn action spend 10 CE and lower all 10 Gears. Travel instantly through a 300-foot, 15-foot-wide line. Creatures make Dexterity saves: failure takes 20d12 force, moves to the end, falls prone, and cannot react; success takes half only. Damage ignores resistance; immunity becomes resistance. Structures automatically fail and take maximum damage. Redline ends; take 4 Drive Dice unavoidable recoil and suffer Technique Burnout.

e038.name: Cartographer’s Reserve
e038.text: Your active-arrow capacity increases by your PB, and arrows created by Directive Inscription last 10 minutes instead of 1 minute. When an inscription would exceed capacity, you may replace existing arrows after placing the new batch, allowing you to see the completed route before choosing which older glyphs vanish.

e038.name: Rescue Vector
e038.text: When a willing creature is targeted by an attack while within 10 feet of one of your arrows, use your reaction, spend 2 CE, and expend that arrow to move the creature its full Arrow Distance in the displayed direction without provoking. Recalculate the attack’s reach, range, line, and cover from the new space; it misses only if the target is no longer legal.

e038.name: Double Bank
e038.text: When you use Projectile Redirection, you may spend 1 additional CE and expend a second active arrow whose space lies in the redirected line. The same attack changes direction again from that arrow before finding its final target. This is one reaction, uses the original attack roll and source, and is an explicit exception to the ordinary one-redirection limit; it cannot be redirected a third time.

e038.name: Shared Vector Edge
e038.text: Once per round after a willing creature activates one or more of your arrows and hits with a weapon attack, use your reaction and spend 1 CE. Add one current Arrow Die per arrow it activated that turn, maximum PB dice, to that hit as force damage. This cannot combine with Acceleraise Boost on the same hit, but it can support a different ally or a later turn.

e039.name: Twin Solar Memory
e039.text: You may maintain two stored solar ranks at once. Pride uses two separately bonded weapons or worn objects; Grace holds two internal memories. Releasing one does not expend the other, but only one memory can be active at a time. A stored true Zenith rank fills both slots and replaces both prior memories.

e039.name: Corona of Command
e039.text: While your effective rank is at least 1, chosen allies within 10 feet have advantage on saves against being frightened. At the start of each of your turns, choose one such ally; it gains temporary HP equal to PB + effective rank. At rank 4 the aura becomes 30 feet and the temporary HP also adds your CE modifier.

e039.name: Night-Prowling Lion
e039.text: At effective rank 0, your Strength has a floor of 14, increasing to 16 at level 11 and 18 at level 18. You may use Lion’s Heat at rank 0, treating its Solar Dice as d4s. This does not raise your effective rank, create sunlight, enable The One, or activate any other feature that requires daylight.

e039.name: Grace Bestowed
e039.text: When a willing creature within 120 feet hits with a weapon, unarmed, natural, or CE attack carrying its own CE, use your reaction and pay Solar Infusion’s normal 1 CE to add your current Solar Infusion damage to that hit. This use counts against every per-turn Solar Infusion limit and receives the same station and Perfect Grace multipliers.

e040.name: Ace in the Hole
e040.text: During a short or long rest, you may charge up to PB Token or Handheld objects you touch. Pay every point of CE normally; those specific charges last 24 hours instead of their ordinary duration. Preparing another object beyond this limit causes one prepared charge of your choice to dissipate. A release, dispel, or destroyed object still ends its charge normally.

e040.name: Twin Conduits
e040.text: You may maintain two Bound Conduits at once. Once on each of your turns while touching both, transfer up to PB Charge between them without an action; neither may exceed its capacity, and transferred Charge keeps the earlier of its two remaining durations. Bonding a third conduit ends one bond of your choice.

e040.name: Kinetic Catch
e040.text: When you see a physical ranged attack made against a creature within 30 feet, after seeing its roll but before resolution, use your reaction and spend 2 CE. Make a CE attack roll. If your total equals or exceeds the triggering attack roll, that attack misses and its projectile lands in an empty hand or at your feet with 1 Charge. This cannot catch an area, energy beam, siege projectile larger than you, artifact, or attack without a physical projectile.

e040.name: Royal Flush
e040.text: After one Cardsharp Barrage resolves, if at least four of its separate attacks hit the same creature, that creature makes a Constitution save. On failure it is stunned until the start of your next turn as overlapping kinetic vectors arrest its body. On success it cannot take reactions until the start of your next turn. The condition is one result of the barrage, not an additional hit or detonation.

e041.name: Reel the Arsenal
e041.text: When a strand is attached to an object held by a creature, you may use Elastic Recall on that strand to rip it free: the holder makes a Strength saving throw against your Technique DC, and on a failure it drops the object, which is pulled up to the Contraction distance toward the strand’s other endpoint. To attach to a held object, hit the holder with an attack and spend 1 CE to leave the string on the object instead of the creature.

e041.name: Snapback Counter
e041.text: When a hostile creature attached to one of your strands completes at least 10 feet of voluntary movement, use your reaction and spend 1 CE to immediately use Elastic Recall on that strand. If the creature fails its save and ends within your reach, make one weapon or unarmed attack against it as part of the same reaction. On hit, the target cannot take reactions until the start of its next turn.

e041.name: Living Texture
e041.text: As an action for 1 CE, apply Texture Surprise across yourself or one willing creature you touch for 1 hour. The disguise moves with the body and can alter visible skin, hair, clothing, markings, and apparent injuries within the same general silhouette and size. It does not change voice, scent, weight, anatomy, CE signature, equipment function, or statistics and uses the normal active-investigation rule.

e041.name: Catch the Impossible
e041.text: Elastic Guard can catch a ranged spell attack, CE attack, or visible energy projectile as well as a physical ranged attack. If your Elastic Guard negates it entirely and catches it, Return to Sender may launch a gum facsimile at a creature within Gum Range: make a ranged CE attack that deals the same damage the caught attack would have dealt. It never copies the original effect, conditions, area, spell level, or other riders.

e042.name: Unbroken Mudra
e042.text: You may complete the prayer gesture with any usable limb or a deliberately moved held weapon, so lacking a free hand does not prevent a Palm; unconsciousness, paralysis, or losing every means of deliberate movement still does. Once on each of your turns, a Prayer Sequence may contain one additional ordinary Palm beyond your Hands per Sequence if you pay that Palm’s normal CE.

e042.name: Great Compassion
e042.text: Guarding Palm rolls one additional Prayer Die and may move its willing protected creature up to 20 feet instead of 10. When Merciful Palm moves a willing creature, choose a second willing creature within 15 feet of the first; move it up to the same distance along the same vector without another roll or CE cost.

e042.name: Opening Salutation
e042.text: Add your CE modifier, minimum +1, to initiative. Immediately after initiative is rolled, once per combat, perform one Merciful Palm on yourself or a willing creature within Palm Reach without an action, reaction, or CE. Resolve this movement before the first turn; it cannot target an unwilling creature.

e042.name: Hundred-and-First Hand: Lotus Prison
e042.text: As an action for 4 CE, choose one creature within Palm Reach and make three ranged CE attacks against it. Each hit deals 2 Prayer Dice of force or radiant damage; add your CE modifier to one hit only. If at least two attacks hit, spectral petals restrain the target until the end of your next turn. The prison has AC equal to your CE save DC and HP equal to 10 × PB; destroying it ends the restraint.

e044.name: Many Names, One Banner
e044.text: Your names answer from afar. When you use Battle Muster, you may call one Regalia into vessel form at a point you can see within 60 feet instead of beside you — a Sky Lion where your allies need it, a shield already in a friend's hands. It still counts against your Active Limit.

e044.name: Line That Casts Out Evil
e044.text: Your Borderline may be up to 120 feet long, may bend once at a point you can see, and ignores chosen nonhostile creatures. A hostile creature that fails its save is also Restrained until the end of its turn. If it succeeds, it crosses and cannot be affected by that Borderline again that turn.

e044.name: Blessed Beyond Death
e044.text: A blessed vessel's devotion extends to its kin. When a non-Blessed Regalia would become Broken, your Blessed Vessel may use its reaction to suffer the breaking in its place: the Blessed Vessel becomes Broken instead, and the other Regalia remains at 1 Integrity.

e044.name: Cavalry of Heaven
e044.text: Every Sky Lion can carry you plus PB willing Medium or smaller creatures. Once on each of your turns after the Lion moves at least 30 feet, one rider may use its reaction to make one weapon attack or take the Disengage action. A creature can benefit from Cavalry of Heaven only once per round.

e045.name: Clean Linework
e045.text: Snap Range increases by 30 feet, Active Edit capacity increases by PB, and Paper Defense rolls one additional RD. You may make the activation mark while both hands are occupied.

e045.name: Smash Cut
e045.text: Once per turn after Panel Step, spend 2 CE to make one weapon attack or Panel Strike without an action. On a hit add one RD and move yourself and the target up to 15 feet in the same direction.

e045.name: Living Illustration
e045.text: As an action, spend 5 CE and choose a creature depicted in an image within Snap Range. You manifest it in an unoccupied space beside that image for 1 hour; it counts as one Active Edit. It has AC 15 + half PB, HP equal to 10 × PB, speed 40 feet, and one attack using your CE attack bonus that deals 2 RD + your CE modifier in an appropriate damage type. It acts immediately after you and Dodges unless you command it with a bonus action. If reduced to 0 HP, dismissed without an action, or no longer within Snap Range at the end of your turn, it folds back into its source image.

e045.name: Unreliable Narrator
e045.text: As an action, spend 3 CE to place a false caption, sound, image, creature, object, or apparent terrain change inside a 30-foot cube within Snap Range for 10 minutes. The scene counts as one Active Edit and can include touch, temperature, scent, and convincing CE texture. A creature that uses an action to investigate makes an Intelligence save against your Technique DC, recognizing the false scene on a success. Physical interaction does not automatically reveal it; the fiction supplies expected resistance but cannot deal damage, restrain a creature, or bear real weight.

e045.name: Continuity Error
e045.text: When you are reduced to 0 HP, killed by damage, or subjected to an incapacitating condition, use your reaction and spend 8 CE to restore your HP, CE, position, dimensions, and conditions to their state at the start of your previous turn. Other creatures, spent items, and scene changes are not reversed. The first use per long rest is safe; each later use before that rest inflicts 2 levels of exhaustion that cannot be prevented or removed until the scene ends.

e045.name: Executive Editor
e045.text: You may use Authorial Privilege a second time in the same round by paying 5 CE beyond that Rewrite’s normal cost. The second use cannot choose Insert Panel or Cut Turn outside your Domain. Inside Final Draft or your Domain, that restriction is removed: X may insert or delete a second turn in the same round, with every ordinary cost, save, and once-per-round limit of the chosen Rewrite still applying.

e046.name: Redmane Greatbow
e046.text: You can mark ammunition as part of firing it. Long-range weapon attacks against a marked creature ignore disadvantage from long range, and once per turn a hit may Pull the target 10 feet.

e046.name: Lion’s Gravity
e046.text: When you succeed on a save against forced movement or prone, use your reaction to place an Anchor mark on yourself and Pull the source 15 feet toward you if it is within Gravity Range.

e046.name: Starcaller’s Mark
e046.text: What the cry cannot crush, it claims. Each creature that succeeds on its save against Starcaller Cry gains a Gravity Mark with the Anchor vector for 1 minute, with no additional save; a creature can carry only one such mark at a time.

e046.name: Grand Conjunction
e046.prereq: Prerequisite: Maximum: Festival of Falling Stars
e046.text: You merge held meteors into a greater one. When you launch meteors as a bonus action, you may merge two or more into a single burst: it creates a 15-foot-radius burst dealing 4d8 per merged meteor, with a Dexterity save for half. Declare the merger before launching.

e047.name: Beast’s Agility
e047.text: After using Beast Step, you may move along walls or ceilings for that movement without falling until it ends, the beast’s stride ignoring the floor’s claim on it.

e047.name: Rune-Eater
e047.text: When a creature with Fate Scars spends 3+ CE on one activation, once per round you may use your reaction to extend all its Fate Scars by 1 round.

e047.name: Black Knife Geometry
e047.text: Black Blade Wave ignores half and three-quarters cover and can originate from the edge of your manifested blade even while you are airborne.

e047.name: The Beast Collects
e047.text: You harvest the dooms you have marked. When you would drop to 0 HP, use your reaction and spend 3 CE to consume all Fate Scars on one creature you can see within 60 feet, regaining 10 HP per scar consumed. If this healing leaves you above 0 HP, you do not fall unconscious.

e048.name: Sigil Shatter
e048.text: As a bonus action, consume all Lunar Sigils on one creature you can perceive within Lunar Range. It takes 5 cold damage per sigil consumed, and its speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of your next turn as the shattered cold sinks into its limbs.

e048.name: Bell of Many Ashes
e048.text: When your Ashen Familiar is destroyed, its ashes remember the cold. It bursts into freezing mist: creatures within 10 feet of it make a Constitution save against your Technique DC, taking 5 cold damage and suffering −10 speed until the end of your next turn on a failure, or half damage on a success.

e048.name: Occult Moon
e048.text: The dark moon returns what it swallows. When Cold Moon Guard fully negates a ranged technique attack, you may immediately make one Lunar Bolt attack against the attacker as part of the same reaction, spending 1 CE or 1 Moon Shard.

e048.name: Fingerslayer Principle
e048.text: Your Dark Moon learns new prey. It may target control effects, barriers, and technique-created constructs in addition to technique manifestations, using the normal suppression check. Domains remain beyond it.

e049.name: Feed the Flame
e049.text: As a bonus action, voluntarily gain 1 Madness, feeding the fire on purpose. The next Frenzy feature you use before the end of your turn deals +1 Frenzy Die.

e049.name: Shabriri’s Cry
e049.text: You learn to aim the howl. While Howl of Frenzy is active, you may use your bonus action to loose a focused cry at one creature within 30 feet that can hear you; it makes a Wisdom save against your Technique DC, becoming frightened of you until the end of its next turn on a failure. The cry adds no Madness.

e049.name: Yellow-Eyed Prophet
e049.text: You can sense frightened, charmed, or Madness-affected creatures within 120 feet even without line of sight.

e049.name: Lord Candidate
e049.text: The first time each long rest you would gain Madness above 10, instead gain PB temporary HP per excess point and remain at 10.

e050.name: Apostle’s Reach
e050.text: In Apostle stance, your opportunity attacks may apply Kindling, paying its normal CE cost — the long limb punishes retreat with godfire.

e050.name: Shared Vestments
e050.text: As a bonus action for 1 CE, extend your Godskin Stance to one willing creature within 15 feet until the start of your next turn. It gains the stance’s passive benefits — Apostle’s speed and reach, or Noble’s armor and stability — but not your armament, Black Flame, or stance actions.

e050.name: Swaddling Cloth
e050.text: When you would gain temporary HP from Swaddling Recovery, you may instead grant those temporary HP to one willing creature within 15 feet, wrapping it in spectral swaddling cloth.

e050.name: Choir of Two
e050.text: Partner gains proficiency in one skill you have; while within 30 feet, you may perceive through its senses without an action.

e051.name: Assassin’s Hands
e051.text: Once per turn after Lightning Palm hits, you may move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks, the discharge grounding through your step and carrying you clear.

e051.name: Ground Current
e051.text: As an action for 2 CE, discharge your Bioelectric Aura into a conductive surface — water, metal, wet stone — within 5 feet of you. Until the start of your next turn, any creature that starts its turn touching that surface within 20 feet of you must succeed on a Constitution save against your Technique DC or lose its reactions until the start of its next turn.

e051.name: Programmed Guard
e051.text: You may write Reflex Programs keyed to your own failures — ’when I fail a Dexterity save, reroute.’ When such a trigger occurs, you may use your reaction to move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks, turning the failure into repositioning.

e051.name: Arc Relay
e051.text: Your palm’s lightning learns to jump. When Lightning Palm hits, you may spend 1 CE to arc the discharge to one creature within 15 feet of the target; it makes a Constitution save against your Technique DC, losing its reactions until the start of its next turn on a failure.

e052.name: Flowing Blade Disciple
e052.text: After moving at least 20 feet on your turn, your first melee attack gains +1 to hit and ignores difficult terrain penalties to its approach.

e052.name: Cleanrot Resolve
e052.text: When you would gain poisoned, diseased, or exhaustion from a toxin, spend 2 CE to make an immediate Constitution save against it with advantage.

e052.name: Waterfowl Savant
e052.text: Waterfowl may target the same creature up to three times instead of twice, but the third hit deals no Lifesteal.

e052.name: Scarlet Valkyrie
e052.text: While wings are active, falling causes no damage and your Aeonian Phantom movement becomes 20 feet.

e053.name: Carian Dueling Form
e053.text: When only one enemy is within 10 feet of you, gain +1 AC against that creature and +PB to checks against disarm/shove.

e053.name: Phalanx Reserve
e053.text: Maximum stored glintblades becomes PB+2; you may create them over multiple activations.

e053.name: Messmer Ember
e053.text: A creature failing Flame Spiral’s save cannot regain HP until start of your next turn.

e053.name: Moon Princess’s Guard
e053.text: If Twin Aspect Guard reduces damage to 0, regain 1 CE once per round.

e054.name: Dragon Communion Savant
e054.text: Learn one additional lineage’s breath rider; you may apply it to your primary Breath by paying +1 CE, without gaining its resistance.

e054.name: Scale Shelter
e054.text: While Gravel Scales is active, as a bonus action you may extend stony plates over one willing creature within 5 feet; it gains +1 AC until the start of your next turn. Your own scales are not diminished by the sharing.

e054.name: Winged Predator
e054.text: After descending at least 20 feet before a melee attack, the target makes a Strength save or falls prone; you land without falling damage.

e054.name: Dragonlord’s Echo
e054.text: The storm answers at a distance. You may originate Dragonstorm at a point you can see within 90 feet instead of centered on yourself, shaping the same 30-foot-radius storm around that point.

e055.name: First Comes Rock
e055.text: The first Charge Beat you gain in combat costs 0 CE.

e055.name: Hidden Hand
e055.text: Creatures have disadvantage on checks to determine which Jajanken choice you will make, and your Feint can target up to PB observers.

e055.name: Greed Island Training
e055.text: While charged, you may use your reaction to add one Jajanken Die to a Strength or Constitution save, then lose one Beat.

e055.name: One More Round
e055.text: After releasing a 5+ Beat Jajanken, move up to half speed without provoking from the creature you targeted.

e056.name: Southpaw Cyclotron
e056.text: Choose left or right arm each time you begin winding. Rotations belong to that arm; you may maintain separate totals, but your global cap is shared.

e056.name: Shoulder Like Steel
e056.text: Cyclotron Guard rolls two dice per Rotation spent, maximum PB Rotations on one reaction.

e056.name: Counting Out Loud
e056.text: If you audibly announce each Rotation and do not conceal the count, the first 5 Rotations each combat add +1 flat damage each in addition to their die.

e056.name: Fifteen Is Plenty
e056.text: When exactly 15 Rotations are spent, add CE modifier to each Cyclotron Die total once and gain advantage on the prone save DC calculation; does not stack with 15+ resistance rider twice.

e057.name: Field Surgeon
e057.text: Blythe can stabilize a dying creature within tether range as a reaction without CE once per round.

e057.name: Invisible Strings
e057.text: Your Puppeteer attachments are hidden from passive CE perception; active Perception/CE check vs your DC reveals them.

e057.name: Feral En
e057.text: You can shape En as a narrow tendril at twice normal range or a broad sphere at one-quarter range.

e057.name: Dance Beyond Death
e057.text: When Terpsichora would end because you are incapacitated, spend 3 CE before becoming unable to act; it persists until end of your next turn and moves you defensively according to a preset command.

e058.name: Kind Creditor
e058.text: When you forgive Debt with Payment Plan or manually before level 11, the debtor gains temporary HP equal PB; cannot affect yourself.

e058.name: Repo Agent
e058.text: Repossession can trigger when a debtor activates a cursed tool costing CE or feeds CE into a barrier, not only an innate technique.

e058.name: Compound Misery
e058.text: When Interest raises Debt by 25+ in one pulse, target speed is reduced 10 feet until next initiative 20 from A.P.R.’s growing weight.

e058.name: No Defaulting
e058.text: A Bankrupt creature cannot hide its CE signature from you and has disadvantage on checks to deceive you about its current CE state.

e059.name: Lung of the Sea
e059.text: You can hold your breath for 30 minutes and have advantage on saves against inhaled poisons/gases.

e059.name: Purple In
e059.text: You may hide the CE signature of up to PB smoke constructs at once; active CE Perception vs your DC can reveal them.

e059.name: Trooper Doctrine
e059.text: Choose one preset doctrine after long rest: Guard (+1 AC), Pursue (+10 speed), or Rescue (can drag willing/unconscious allies without speed penalty). All Details use it.

e059.name: Jailhouse Rock
e059.text: Your jail can roll. When you create Smoky Jail, you may anchor it to yourself so it moves with you, keeping its radius centered on you. A rolling jail’s barrier HP is reduced by 5 × PB (minimum 10) — mobility has a price in smoke.

e060.name: Low Waltz
e060.text: As a bonus action, send one active top spinning into a hostile creature’s space within 30 feet of the top. The creature makes a Dexterity save against your Technique DC or falls prone, tripped by the waltzing top; the top then returns to its previous position.

e060.name: Gyro Balance
e060.text: As a bonus action, attune one willing creature within 30 feet to your tops’ gyroscopic rhythm until the start of your next turn. It has advantage on ability checks and saving throws against being knocked prone, steadied by the hum.

e060.name: Blue Shot
e060.text: When using single-target Shotgun Blues, sacrifice one selected top to add 2 Top Dice; the sacrificed top shatters after damage.

e060.name: Ringmaster
e060.text: You may designate PB willing creatures that your simple “attack nearby” orders automatically treat as friendly.

e061.name: Armored Vessel
e061.text: Increase Safe Output by 5 percentage points, maximum 100%.Once per turn when calculating Overdraw, reduce Recoil Steps by 1 (minimum 1).Gain proficiency in Constitution saves if you do not already have it; if already proficient, add +1 to Anime & Manga injury saves.

e061.name: Blackwhip Savant
e061.text: Blackwhip range increases by 30 ft.You may maintain grapples on up to PB creatures, though each requires its own tendril.Once per turn a Blackwhip lash or collision deals +1 Stockpile Die.Rescue Line may move a willing creature up to 30 ft instead of 15.

e061.name: Vestige Harmony
e061.prereq: Prerequisite: at least two awakened Vestiges
e061.text: Choose one awakened Vestige sub-technique after each long rest.The first activation of that Vestige each turn costs 1 less CE, minimum 0.During Vestige Council, add the Stockpile Die to one additional mental/technique check per short rest.

e061.name: Smash Artisan
e061.prereq: Prerequisite: Air Force or Kinetic Surge
e061.text: Choose Air Force, Kinetic Surge, or Close Smash after each long rest.Air Force: range doubles. Kinetic Surge: maximum Charges increase by 1. Close Smash: once per turn reroll one Stockpile Die showing its minimum value.The choice may change each long rest, representing technique refinement rather than permanent anatomy.

e099.name: Passive Filter
e099.text: Your first Vector Filter reflection each round costs 0 CE against mundane physical attacks; against CE attacks it still costs normally.

e099.name: Kihara Counterstudy
e099.text: After a creature bypasses your Filter once, gain advantage on the next Calculation check made specifically against that bypass method.

e099.name: Borrowed Vector
e099.text: Reaction when an ally within 30 ft willingly moves: redirect up to 20 ft of that movement to yourself or another willing creature.

e099.name: White Wings
e099.text: When Black Wings would end, spend 4 CE to continue for 1 additional round and immediately end one frightened, charmed, restrained, or prone condition on yourself.

e100.name: Good Dog
e100.text: A creature you successfully Compel gains temp HP equal to PB + CE modifier when it first obeys a dangerous command.

e100.name: Contract Lawyer
e100.text: You may maintain PB + CE modifier written contracts and have advantage on checks to identify loopholes or coercive language in supernatural bargains.

e100.name: Lower Yourself
e100.text: Bonus action, 2 CE: one creature you damaged this turn makes Wis save; failure is Frightened of you until end next turn and therefore becomes Dominion-eligible.

e100.name: Remote Handler
e100.text: You may issue simple commands telepathically to Dominated creatures within 1 mile.

e101.name: Vrrrm Vrrrm
e101.text: Starting Rip Cord also lets you move 10 ft without provoking.

e101.name: Blood Drinker
e101.text: Blood token maximum increases by 2 and healing rerolls 1s once.

e101.name: Door to Hell
e101.text: When you reduce a cursed spirit to 0 HP, learn whether it has previously manifested elsewhere or can reincarnate under campaign lore.

e101.name: Save Me, Chainsaw Man
e101.text: Reaction when an ally within 60 ft drops to 0 HP: move up to speed toward them and make one chainsaw attack against a creature adjacent to them.

e102.name: Ki Savant
e102.text: Ki Read radius becomes 60 ft and grants advantage on initiative instead of +2.

e102.name: Dark Cloaked Blade
e102.text: Your weapon counts as magical/cursed while technique is available and may deal necrotic instead of its normal physical type.

e102.name: Black Hole Mastery
e102.text: On a successful Black Hole contest, gain 1 CE once/round, representing reclaimed hostile output.

e102.name: Surpass Your Limits
e102.text: Once/long rest when you begin your turn below 25% HP, immediately regain PB CE and end Technique Burnout.

e103.name: Second Hand
e103.text: When initiative is rolled, gain PB TU.

e103.name: Precise Stasis
e103.text: You may allow a frozen target to perceive/speak while still preventing movement/actions.

e103.name: Borrowed Second
e103.text: Reaction, spend 3 TU to grant an ally within 30 ft +10 ft movement and one object interaction immediately.

e103.name: Grand Clock
e103.text: Chrono Anastasis radius increases to 50 ft, but its CE/TU costs remain unchanged.

e104.name: Anti-Magic Swordsman
e104.text: Gain +1 AC while wielding one anti-cursed sword and not wearing heavy armor.

e104.name: Bull Thrust
e104.text: After Dashing at least 20 ft straight, bonus action make one anti-cursed sword attack.

e104.name: Sword Flight
e104.text: Ride Demon-Slayer/Dweller for fly speed equal walking while Black Form is active.

e104.name: Liebe's Partner
e104.text: When Devil Union would end from reaching 0 Anti-Energy, it lasts until end of current turn and grants advantage on your final anti-cursed attack.

e105.name: Dustproof
e105.text: You are immune to your own Decay damage and created terrain hazards.

e105.name: Chain Reaction
e105.text: A creature reduced to 0 by Decay automatically spreads 1 Mark to all creatures touching it.

e105.name: Selective Hand
e105.text: You can make ordinary hand contact without accidental Decay even under stress; advantage on saves against effects that would force your technique to trigger.

e105.name: Ruined City
e105.text: Awakening-created difficult terrain remains for the scene and gives you half cover while prone/crawling through debris.

e106.name: Living Architecture
e106.text: Terrain you create has AC 16 and HP 10 × PB per 10-ft section.

e106.name: Clean Fusion
e106.text: Willing Fusion no longer requires 1 minute; action, but still costs AP/CE.

e106.name: Plague Mask
e106.text: Advantage on saves against poison, disease, airborne hazards, and touch-transmitted curses.

e107.name: Baskerville
e107.text: Black Hound damage increases by one die and can grapple Large or smaller targets using your CE attack bonus.

e107.name: Casull & Jackal
e107.text: Gain paired cursed firearms; ranged attacks 60/240 ft use Dex or CE ability and qualify for technique riders, but not for automatic soul consumption.

e107.name: No Life King
e107.text: Extra Life can trigger while Incapacitated unless the effect suppresses soul/technique features.

e107.name: Named Dead
e107.text: You may retain PB + 2 Elite/Named souls rather than PB.

e108.name: Crimson Bullet
e108.text: Spend 5 extra Repair after firing to add 2 Undead Dice and increase range to 120 ft.

e108.name: Bloody Arts
e108.text: After propelling at least 20 ft, next melee hit this turn gains +2 Undead Dice.

e108.name: Sword in the Body
e108.text: Draw/store one one-handed weapon inside your regenerating body; cannot be disarmed of it while conscious.

e108.name: Never Stop
e108.text: Once/short rest when Restrained, Paralyzed, or Stunned, spend 10 Repair to repeat the relevant save immediately.

e109.name: Rapid Slash:
e109.text: Trick followed by Yamato gains advantage once/turn.

e109.name: Dark Slayer:
e109.text: At 10 Concentration, reaction Trick after being targeted.

e110.name: Enemy Step:
e110.text: after melee hit, jump 10 ft without provoking.

e110.name: Jackpot:
e110.text: once/turn ranged crit adds 2d8 and raises Style.

e111.name: Long Blade:
e111.text: Masamune reach +5 ft on your turn.

e111.name: Peerless SOLDIER:
e111.text: Octaslash may move 10 ft between attacks.

e111.name: Black Materia:
e111.text: Supernova charge cannot be interrupted by ordinary damage once/long rest.

e112.name: Bat Within:
e112.text: failed dodge can spend 1 Tempo to halve damage.

e112.name: Accessory Witch:
e112.text: bind one extra magical accessory effect.

e113.name: Precision:
e113.text: Lightning Bolt ignores half cover and crits 19–20 if you did not move.

e113.name: Polarity Wall:
e113.text: reaction 1 Charge for +3 AC vs projectile.

e113.name: Karmic Overload:
e113.text: once/long rest Charge costs become 0 for one round.

e114.name: Digital Angel:
e114.text: Video flight lasts to start next turn.

e114.name: Concrete Skin:
e114.text: reaction 1 CE gain resistance B/P/S for one hit.

e115.name: Parkour Predator:
e115.text: climb speed = speed and long jumps doubled.

e115.name: Patsy:
e115.text: advantage on deception while using consumed identity.

e115.name: Adaptive Biomass:
e115.text: after taking same damage type 3 times, resistance until combat ends once/long rest.

e115.name: Pack Leader:
e115.text: create one weak infected companion from 15 Biomass for 10 minutes.

e116.name: Let Me Solo:
e116.text: advantage on first save against a boss fought before.

e116.name: Rune Arc:
e116.text: once/long rest empower Great Rune for 1 minute.

e116.name: Thy Strength Befits a Crown:
e116.text: when you defeat a boss, regain PB CE and Inspiration.

e117.name: Spider-Sense Echo:
e117.text: +PB initiative and cannot be surprised at Bond 3+.

e117.name: Eat Your Brains:
e117.text: grappled enemy damaged by bite grants temp HP.

e118.name: Blood Trail:
e118.text: know direction of creature you wounded within 1 mile for 1 hour.

e118.name: Wall of Teeth:
e118.text: reaction when a creature hits you with a melee attack: the symbiote lashes out — the attacker takes piercing damage equal to PB.

e118.name: Red Rain:
e118.text: Shard Volley can split between two targets.

e118.name: Born Killer:
e118.text: once/turn +1d8 against target below half HP.

e119.name: Hard-Light Step:
e119.text: reaction create foothold and move 10 ft.

e119.name: Fine Control:
e119.text: force constructs can manipulate objects like spectral hands.

e119.name: Mother's Shield:
e119.text: Force Screen protecting an ally gains +10 Integrity.

e120.name: Skywriter:
e120.text: perfect smoke/fire shaping for communication and feints.

e120.name: Thermal Updraft:
e120.text: carry one willing creature while flying without speed loss.

e120.name: Flame Cage:
e120.text: 2 CE ring of fire restrains movement through threat of 3d8 fire.

e121.name: Lucky Hex:
e121.text: regain one Chaos Die on natural 1 by hostile once/short rest.

e121.name: What Hex?
e121.text: once/long rest ignore one Chaos Surge.

e121.name: Witch's Grief:
e121.text: below 25% HP, Chaos Die rolls maximize once/turn.

e122.name: Hulk Catch:
e122.text: reaction catch huge projectile and throw back.

e122.name: Banner's Mind:
e122.text: suppress Hulk Out voluntarily and retain memories/control.

e122.name: Green Scar:
e122.text: advantage vs Frightened and mind control while Rage 5+.

e123.name: Hidden Doombot:
e123.text: once/long rest reveal defeated “you” was decoy if logically prepared.

e123.name: DOOM Does Not Beg:
e123.text: once/short rest reroll failed Wis/Cha save.

e124.name: Faster Than a Bullet:
e124.text: reaction move 20 ft to intercept attack on ally.

e124.name: Freeze Breath:
e124.text: Super Breath can restrain on failed Con.

e124.name: Hope:
e124.text: allies within 10 ft advantage vs Frightened while you stand.

e125.name: Warrior Born:
e125.text: swap bound divine weapon at rest.

e126.name: Creative Mind:
e126.text: one extra utility effect from complex constructs.

e126.name: Fearless:
e126.text: gain 1 Will first time Frightened effect targets you each combat.

e126.name: Emergency Protocol:
e126.text: ring stabilizes you at 0 HP once/long rest.

e127.name: Ghost:
e127.text: Phase duration can extend by 1 CE/round with Focus.

e127.name: Fear of Flame:
e127.text: after succeeding fire Fear save, gain 1d10 temp HP as resolve.

e128.name: Final Crisis:
e128.text: once/long rest Omega Sanction costs no Dominion.

e129.name: False Memory:
e129.text: illusions gain advantage against a creature whose thoughts you read.

e130.name: Gravecrawler:
e130.text: one Zombie returns at 1 HP once/combat.

e130.name: Cruel Bargain:
e130.text: sacrifice may grant +1d8 to next technique.

e130.name: Liliana's Triumph:
e130.text: when summon dies, one adjacent hostile takes PB necrotic.

e131.name: Young Pyromancer:
e131.text: first 3+ CE fire spell creates 1-HP elemental token.

e131.name: Reckless Spark:
e131.text: take PB damage to reroll one fire damage die pool.

e131.name: Can't Be Extinguished:
e131.text: once per long rest, when you take damage while Ember is 5+, use your reaction to erupt: the attacker takes PBd8 fire, Dexterity save for half, and you gain 1 Ember.

e132.name: Lotus Cobra:
e132.text: entering a new Land grants 1d8 temp HP.

e132.name: Nature's Claim:
e132.text: structures take +2 dice from your land effects.

e133.name: Untap:
e133.text: once/short rest regain 2 Time Counters after a delayed effect resolves.

e134.name: Schemer:
e134.text: advantage Deception/Intimidation after reading a mind.

e134.name: Bolas's Citadel:
e134.text: at half HP, first Echo each round costs 1 less CE.

e135.name: Voltaic Key:
e135.text: once/round move an Artifact 10 ft free.

e136.name: Ancient Grudge:
e136.text: +1d8 vs creature that damaged you last round.

e136.name: Sanguine Bond:
e136.text: once/turn healing yourself deals PB necrotic to marked foe.

e137.name: Dream Eater:
e137.text: Nightmare damage grants 1d8 temp HP once/turn.

e138.name: Primal Hunter:
e138.text: marked target cannot hide from beasts.

e138.name: Unnatural Predation:
e138.text: reaction command beast to attack enemy that harms ally once/short rest.

e139.name: Master Transmuter:
e139.text: swap one Blueprint after short rest.

e139.name: Blind Seer:
e139.text: identify cursed tool properties by touch.

e140.name: Toxic:
e140.text: Infection cap becomes 4 but penalties still cap at 3.

e140.name: Gitaxian Probe:
e140.text: analyze one target's resistances as bonus action 1 CE.

e141.name: Emrakul's Whisper:
e141.text: once/long rest impose disadvantage on one Wis save.

e142.name: Gemhide:
e142.text: sacrifice one Sliver to regain 1 CE.

e142.name: Hibernation:
e142.text: dismiss brood as reaction to halve AoE damage.

e142.name: Necrotic:
e142.text: when Sliver dies, adjacent hostile takes 1d8 necrotic.

e143.name: Mana Dork:
e143.text: one temporary rank per short rest without CE.

e143.name: Fetchland:
e143.text: redistribute one Mastery point as action once/short rest.

e143.name: Command Tower:
e143.text: while all five colors at 1+, +1 technique saves.

e143.name: Progenitus Echo:
e143.text: once/long rest resistance all damage for one hit.

e144.name: Museum-Grade Repair
e144.text: Your golden seams hold stronger than the original: when you fully repair an object, construct, or cursed tool, you can lace the break with gold. The next time it would take damage, it takes none instead, once per object.

e144.name: Beautiful Scar
e144.text: A creature you Mend yourself (an ally’s self-seal with Seal the Seam does not count) gains advantage on its next saving throw before the end of your next turn. Once per creature per short rest.

e144.name: Shatterpoint
e144.text: When a hostile creature reaches its maximum number of Fractures, you may immediately move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. Your next attack against it before the end of the turn has advantage.

e145.name: Foundation First
e145.text: You survey foundations before the first blow: if you spend 10 minutes studying a location, you can designate up to PB willing creatures there as Supports the instant initiative is rolled within the next 24 hours, without using an action.

e145.name: Shock Absorber
e145.text: When you take damage redirected through Weight Distribution, you can Discharge the shock as part of the same reaction: one creature within 15 feet makes a Dexterity save or takes that damage as thunder and is pushed 10 feet away from you. Once per round.

e145.name: Counterweight
e145.text: When you push a creature with Discharge, you may move the same distance in the opposite direction without provoking opportunity attacks.

e146.name: Sailor’s Hands
e146.text: You can splice your cords through existing Knots: when you tie a Knot, you may route it through another creature or object already bearing one of your Knots, extending your tying range to 60 feet for that Knot and ignoring cover between the relay and the target.

e146.name: Quick Release
e146.text: When one of your Knots ends, move up to 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. Once per turn.

e146.name: Executioner’s Knot
e146.text: As an action for 3 CE, you can tie a hangman's noose around a creature bearing 3+ of your Knots within 30 feet: it makes a Constitution save or is restrained until the end of your next turn, unable to speak or use verbal components while the noose holds.

e147.name: Seismograph
e147.text: You can read the earth's complaints: as an action, take a seismic reading. You learn how many creatures within 60 feet are touching the ground, and whether any Huge or larger creature is moving within 300 feet.

e147.name: Hairline Crack
e147.text: When you roll initiative, place one Fault on a visible surface or creature that has already taken damage, no action required.

e147.name: Cascade Failure
e147.text: After a creature bearing your Fault drops to 0 HP, one Fault within 30 feet immediately gains 2 Strain.

e148.name: Joseki Study
e148.text: After a short rest, recover one destroyed Stone. Once per round when you place a Stone adjacent to another Stone, gain temporary HP equal to your proficiency bonus.

e148.name: Sacrifice Play
e148.text: Reaction when one of your Stones would be destroyed: detonate it. Creatures within 5 feet make a Dexterity save or take 2 Influence Dice force damage.

e148.name: Reading Ahead
e148.text: At the start of combat, after initiative is rolled, place one Stone within 10 feet of yourself for free.

e149.name: Old Growth
