e149.text: After a long rest, choose one of your Nodes to become old growth: it becomes Large with double HP and counts as two Connected Nodes for adjacency and teleportation, but it can never be converted into a Bloom.

e149.name: Medicinal Culture
e149.text: You cultivate a healing strain: as an action for 1 Nutrient, graft a poultice onto a willing creature within 10 feet of a Node. The poultice persists until the bearer actually takes damage — it does not expire after 1 minute, and if the bearer phases out of a blow (such as through Distributed Organism) and takes no damage, the poultice remains, ready for the hit that actually lands. When that happens, the poultice bursts and heals it for 2 Spore Dice.

e149.name: Cordyceps Reflex
e149.text: When a hostile creature within 10 feet of a Node falls prone, grappled, or restrained, gain 1 Nutrient. Once per round.

e150.name: Archivist’s Eye
e150.text: Record capacity increases by 2 and you can identify whether an object has been magically altered since you last touched it.

e150.name: Margin Walker
e150.text: When you use Position Note on yourself, returning to the Record does not use your reaction once per short rest.

e150.name: Errata
e150.text: When a creature succeeds on a save against Position Note or Redaction, it still subtracts one Revision Die from its speed until the end of the turn.

e151.name: Emergency Lane
e151.text: As a bonus action, declare one of your Lanes an emergency lane until the start of your next turn: willing creatures traveling along it gain 10 feet of speed, and the first hostile creature each turn that enters it must make a Strength save or be pushed 10 feet along the lane's direction.

e151.name: Traffic Camera
e151.text: You know the current speed and number of Citations of every creature standing in one of your Lanes.

e151.name: Repeat Offender
e151.text: When a creature reaches 3 Citations, your attacks against it ignore half cover until its Citations are spent.

e152.name: Perfumer’s Case
e152.text: You can decant a formula into a thrown vial: as an action, throw one prepared bottle up to 30 feet. It shatters on impact, applying its effect in a 10-foot radius (single-target formulas allow a Dexterity save for half). A thrown Courage Accord is a splash of fortitude: each creature in the radius that fails the Dexterity save gains half the Veil’s temporary HP (rounded down); every creature’s Scent Veil still blooms when depleted.

e152.name: Cold Extraction
e152.text: You can gather Hunter’s Trace from a scene up to 24 hours old if physical residue remains.

e152.name: Acquired Taste
e152.text: A creature that fails its save against one of your formulas develops a craving for it: for the next hour, you can use a bonus action and 1 CE to release a trace of that scent. The craving creature must make a Wisdom save or use its reaction to move up to half its speed toward you by the safest route.

e153.name: Organized Shelving
e153.text: Archive capacity increases by 10 objects and retrieving a mundane archived object costs 0 CE once per turn.

e153.name: No Receipt Needed
e153.text: When you successfully disarm a creature, you may Archive the dropped eligible object immediately without using your reaction.

e153.name: Premium Loaner
e153.text: Choose Weapon, Barricade, or Restraint after each long rest. The first time each short rest you create that Loaner, it costs no Claim Ticket.

e154.name: Blink Hunter
e154.text: When a creature that is currently Observing you spends or loses its reaction for any other reason, its Observation immediately ends. Once per round this may trigger Blink Reflex.

e154.name: Concrete Idol
e154.text: If you willingly move 0 feet on your turn, you may use a reaction before your next turn to reduce one damage instance by 5 × PB + CE modifier.

e154.name: No Peripheral Vision
e154.text: If exactly one Observer can see you, you may attempt Blind Spot Step by paying +2 CE. That Observer makes a Wisdom save; on failure it experiences a micro-blink and ceases Observing before the Step resolves.

e154.name: Neck-Line Anatomy
e154.text: Once per short rest when Snap Strike hits and the target fails its Constitution save by 5 or more, it is stunned until the end of your next turn instead of the normal failed-save result.

e155.name: Grief-Fueled Momentum
e155.text: Once per round when your Quarry damages you, gain 1 Fury after that damage resolves.

e155.name: Unseen Photograph
e155.text: Your cursed face imprints may be as small as a four-pixel detail. A creature must actually perceive the detail to become a Witness; merely possessing the image is not enough.

e155.name: No Rest Until Silence
e155.text: When your Quarry drops to 0 HP, retain up to half your current Fury until the end of your next turn. If you choose another Witness as Quarry before then, transfer that Fury.

e155.name: Inhuman Acceleration
e155.text: Once per short rest, when you start your turn at least 60 feet from the Quarry, you may Dash without an action and your movement that turn may cross liquid surfaces and vertical walls.

e156.name: House Call
e156.text: Clinical Touch and The Cure gain 15-foot reach through a spectral gloved hand. This does not let you pass through total cover.

e156.name: Second Opinion
e156.text: After examining a creature, your next successful Clinical Touch against it before the end of your next turn applies 2 Symptoms instead of 1. Once per creature per short rest.

e156.name: Field Surgeon
e156.text: Outside combat, Crude Surgery takes 1 minute instead of 10. In combat, a corpse you personally reduced to 0 HP may be made a Patient as a full-turn action for 4 CE even before level 11.

e156.name: Humoral Imbalance
e156.text: A creature with 4+ Symptoms also has its speed reduced by 10 feet and cannot take reactions after it fails a Constitution save against your technique until the start of its next turn.

e157.name: Black Mucus
e157.text: A Surface Mark creates a 5-foot patch of difficult terrain for enemies. A creature that falls prone in it cannot stand without spending an additional 5 feet of movement.

e157.name: Predator Beneath
e157.text: After Threshold Walk, you may remain partially submerged until the start of your next turn. You have half cover but your speed is 0 and you cannot make opportunity attacks while submerged.

e157.name: Liquefying Grip
e157.text: When you apply the third Corrosion Mark to a creature, it cannot take reactions until the end of its next turn and you may attempt to grapple it as part of the same attack.

e157.name: Recall Protocol
e157.text: Once per short rest when damage would reduce you below one-quarter HP, use your reaction and 2 CE to teleport to any Surface Mark within 120 feet after the damage resolves.

e158.name: Perfect Voiceprint
e158.text: Your mimicry extends beyond speech: you can reproduce any nonverbal sound made by a creature whose voice you have archived — breathing, crying, footsteps — and layer two archived sounds at once, a voice calling from one direction and footsteps from another.

e158.name: Dark Hunter
e158.text: Your voice hunts ahead of you: as a bonus action for 1 CE, project a Voiceprint to a point within 60 feet. Until the start of your next turn you can hear through that point as if you were there, and your blindsight extends 30 feet from it.

e158.name: No New Memories
e158.text: A creature that fails its save against your Amnestic Breath also loses its short-term memory of the last minute: for the next hour it cannot describe you, recall the room's layout, or remember orders received in that time.

e158.name: Pack Echo
e158.text: When an ally within 30 feet attacks a creature with 2+ Lost Moments, use your reaction and 1 CE to make the target hear the ally from the wrong direction. That attack gains advantage; this does not make you hidden.

e159.name: Retained Mutation
e159.text: Choose one Threat Tag when you finish a long rest. Preserve 1 Data in that Tag instead of losing all of it.

e159.name: Hostile Evolution
e159.text: Once per turn after a creature damages you with a Tag for which you have an installed Adaptation, your next hit against that creature before the end of your next turn deals +1 Adaptation Die damage.

e159.name: Keter Genome
e159.text: Gain +1 Adaptation Slot. Installing or replacing an Adaptation in this bonus Slot costs +1 CE.

e159.name: Consume and Rebuild
e159.text: During a short rest you may consume or incorporate a meaningful quantity of organic or inorganic matter. Regain PB Adaptation Dice HP and gain 1 Data for one environmental or material Threat Tag that the consumed matter reasonably demonstrates; GM adjudicates the Tag.

e160.name: Honeyed Words
e160.text: Once per turn when you succeed on Deception, Persuasion, or Intimidation against a creature currently at 0 Temptation, you may spend 1 CE to give it 1 Temptation without using an action.

e160.name: Black Ichor
e160.text: When Corrosive Secretion corrodes an unattended surface, leave a 5-foot corrosive patch until the start of your next turn. A creature entering it for the first time on a turn has its speed halved until the start of your next turn, maximum once per turn.

e160.name: Borrowed Aptitude
e160.text: When you enter a living Host, choose one skill in which that Host is proficient. You gain proficiency in it while possessing that body; if already proficient, you gain no additional expertise.

e160.name: Never Without a Face
e160.text: During a short rest, designate one valid nonliving vessel — a corpse, mannequin, or statue you have prepared — within 1 mile as your contingency. The first time within the next 24 hours that a Host ejects you or reaches 0 Integrity, your consciousness transfers to the contingency vessel immediately without spending CE or an action, instead of returning to the Prime Host or falling free.

e161.name: Salvage Intake
e161.text: When a construct, vehicle, or unattended object is destroyed within 30 feet of your manifested Clockworks, you may use your reaction to feed the wreckage straight into the Intake, gaining Scrap as though you had used Rough on it for its size, without spending an action.

e161.name: Restorative Refinement
e161.text: When you activate Very Fine, you may choose restoration instead of rolling: rebuild one damaged or broken mundane object, or one non-Special-Grade cursed tool, placed in the Intake, restoring it to full function and clearing the broken condition. Pay the normal activation cost; no roll is made and no Risk is gained.

e161.name: Decoupled Line
e161.text: When you manifest the Clockworks, you may place the Intake and Output frames up to 30 feet apart — both within 60 feet of you — instead of adjacent. Items fed into the Intake emerge refined from the Output normally.

e161.name: Hot-Swap Tuning
e161.text: As a bonus action, move one active Fine upgrade from an item you touch to another valid item you touch; the upgrade’s remaining duration continues on the new item. An item may still hold only one Fine upgrade.

e162.name: Flat-Pack Engineer
e162.text: Increase Merchandise capacity by 1. Once per short rest create one Merchandise without spending CE.

e162.name: Landmark Cartographer
e162.text: You and willing creatures you designate add PB to Search for an Exit checks. During Closing Warning, you always know the shortest traversable route to every existing Settlement, Store Node, and manifested Exit.

e162.name: Night Watch
e162.text: When Closed Hours begins, you may use your reaction to choose up to PB creatures inside one Settlement you can perceive. Until the next Store Phase, those creatures gain +2 AC against Staff attacks and may make opportunity attacks against Staff that enter or leave the Settlement.

e162.name: Exchange & Returns
e162.text: When Open Hours begins, instead of restoring Merchandise or removing Remains with Restocking Cycle, choose one Settlement that survived the previous Closed Hours. Every willing creature inside it may immediately spend one Hit Die and regain that much HP without using an action.

e163.name: Bridgewatcher
e163.text: When initiative is rolled, choose one visible structure, vehicle, barrier, or terrain feature. You know whether it is currently stable, damaged, trapped, or likely to catastrophically fail within the next minute. If it fails during the encounter, gain 2 Omens.

e163.name: Scarlet Afterimage
e163.text: When Eyes Before the Storm moves a creature, leave a red afterimage in its old space until the start of its next turn. The first hostile attack made through or into that space is made with disadvantage.

e163.name: Bad Feeling
e163.text: Once per short rest, after the GM describes a location but before the party commits to entering it, spend 1 CE to ask whether an immediate physical or cursed threat is present within 300 feet. The answer is yes/no/unclear; it does not identify the threat.

e163.name: Prophet of Impact
e163.text: Prerequisite: Disaster Clock. When a Clock reaches 3, you may spend 2 Omens to mark one 10-foot square you can see. If the marked creature enters that square before your next turn, it falls prone and cannot take reactions until the end of that movement.

e164.name: Eddy Reading
e164.text: While your Veil is active, you read the atmosphere eddying around bodies: you know the direction and distance of every creature inside the Veil that has at least 1 Exposure, even if you cannot see them.

e164.name: Sickening Trail
e164.text: Spaces you leave during your turn remain Veiled until the start of your next turn. A creature can gain Exposure from only one of your Veil areas per turn.

e164.name: Static Autopsy
e164.text: After observing a creature with Exposure 3+ for one round, learn whether its highest saving throw is Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or mental (Int/Wis/Cha).

e164.name: Red Star Descent
e164.text: Prerequisite: Floating Apparition. When you descend at least 20 feet immediately before using Atmospheric Pulse, you may drive the Veil down with you: the Pulse affects only creatures within 10 feet of you, but creatures that fail the save gain 2 Exposure instead of 1.

e165.name: Roofline Hunter
e165.text: Climbing costs no extra movement and you may run across vertical surfaces during your turn if you end on a legal surface or remain flying.

e165.name: Hellish Whinny
e165.text: When a creature fails its save against Devil’s Cry, its panic betrays it: for 1 minute you always know its direction and distance, and it cannot become hidden from you. This does not let you see it while invisible, but you know which space it occupies.

e165.name: Near Miss
e165.text: When a creature misses you with an opportunity attack, gain 1 Pursuit, once per round. The hunt feeds on near misses.

e165.name: Broken-Bridle Pursuit
e165.text: Prerequisite: Marked Quarry. When your Quarry imposes restrained, grappled, or prone on you, gain 2 Pursuit after the condition is applied.

e166.name: Polite Stranger
e166.text: You may deliver Offer through a phone, speaker, intercom, or other live two-way communication within 1 mile. The target must hear and voluntarily accept.

e166.name: Take My Hand
e166.text: Add one Offer option: the target may stand from prone and move 10 feet toward you without provoking. If accepted, you may move 10 feet toward it as well.

e166.name: Guest Right
e166.text: While inside a Threshold whose controller has invited you, you cannot be surprised, and you sense whenever a creature enters or leaves that Threshold.

e166.name: The Eyes Are Wrong
e166.text: A creature that has granted you 2+ Open Doors has disadvantage on Insight checks against you and cannot benefit from being invisible against your technique senses.

e167.name: Tall Enough
e167.text: Your standing jump distance and height double, and you may step over Large or smaller creatures without treating their spaces as difficult terrain.

e167.name: Walk Behind the Camera
e167.text: If you end your turn in dim light or darkness after moving 30+ feet, you may Hide without an action once per round.

e167.name: Friendly Procession
e167.text: When an ally moves along your Procession Path, you may use your reaction to move up to 15 feet along the same path without provoking opportunity attacks, falling in step behind them.

e167.name: Dropped Frame
e167.text: Prerequisite: Processional Echoes. When an attack misses you due to Echo disadvantage, gain 1 Step.

e168.name: Count Again
e168.text: When a creature fails an Insight check to identify you or a decoy, it is left doubting every face: it has disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn.

e168.name: Campfire Voice
e168.text: You can perfectly reproduce any voice heard for at least 1 minute, though this alone never grants a Headcount benefit.

e168.name: Wrong Footprints
e168.text: As an action and 1 CE, create false tracks, scent, and mundane evidence for one Headcount creature across a 60-foot trail.

e168.name: Seventh Shadow
e168.text: Prerequisite: There Were Six of Us. Your decoy may take the Help action once on your turn; doing so destroys it after the helped roll resolves.

e169.name: Livestock Sense
e169.text: You can determine whether a creature you can smell within 30 feet currently has CE and whether it is above or below half HP.

e169.name: Spraying Wound
e169.text: Once per turn, when you score a critical hit with a piercing or slashing melee attack, you may mark a second creature within 5 feet of the target with a Feeding Wound without spending CE; it counts against your maximum active wounds.

e169.name: Packless Hunter
e169.text: When no ally is within 15 feet of you, your solitude is a weapon: once per turn when you hit a wounded creature, you may drive it from the herd. It makes a Wisdom saving throw against your technique DC, becoming frightened of you until the end of your next turn on a failure.

e169.name: Purging Molt
e169.text: As an action, regress one stage on the Metamorphosis track (minimum Gaunt Predator) to slough tainted flesh: end one poisoned condition or disease affecting you.

e170.name: Sand Listener
e170.text: As an action, press yourself to one of your Tremor Path segments and read its memory: learn the number, size categories, and direction of travel of creatures that crossed that segment in the last 10 minutes.

e170.name: False Tremor
e170.text: As an action and 1 CE, create a fake Path signature within 60 feet that lasts 10 minutes and fools ordinary tremor detection.

e170.name: Venom Static
e170.text: When one creature takes both acid and lightning damage from you in the same round, its nerves short-circuit: it cannot take reactions until the start of your next turn.

e170.name: Buried Ambush
e170.text: If combat begins while you are underground in one of your existing Paths, you may spend 1 CE to Erupt against a creature within 10 feet of your position before the first round begins, resolving the attack before initiative order starts.

e171.name: Wood Ape
e171.text: Gain proficiency in Athletics and Survival; if already proficient in either, gain expertise in that skill.

e171.name: Tree Line
e171.text: You may climb natural surfaces at full speed and gain half cover while at least 10 feet above the ground among dense branches/foliage.

e171.name: No Clear Photo
e171.text: A creature using a divination, camera, scope, or recording device to identify you must beat your CE DC with its relevant check if you have at least 1 Evidence.

e171.name: Track the Tracker
e171.text: When a creature succeeds on tracking you and grants Evidence, learn its direction and approximate distance for 1 hour.

e172.name: Shiny Eyes
e172.text: The swarm sheds dim light 10 feet when you choose and can see invisible creatures within its space.

e172.name: Roof Scratcher
e172.text: A creature starting its turn directly beneath the swarm on a ceiling makes Wisdom save or has disadvantage on its first attack that turn.

e172.name: Tiny Thieves
e172.text: Grab may target a worn pouch, keyring, magazine, potion, phone, talisman, or similarly small accessible object, but never armor, an attuned item, or an object physically integrated into the target.

e172.name: No Bodies Found
e172.text: When the swarm disperses, it leaves no corpse or permanent material — and it may complete one last delivery: it deposits one object it is holding in an unoccupied space within 60 feet of its position before vanishing.

e173.name: Snake Crown
e173.text: You gain blindsight 10 feet from the snakes’ senses and advantage on Perception based on vibration or scent.

e173.name: Do Not Look Away
e173.text: When an Averting creature voluntarily moves away from you, use reaction and 1 CE to move 10 feet toward it.

e173.name: Mirror-Bearer
e173.text: You can make one weapon, shield, or carried object you touch count as a polished reflection for Bronze Reflection.

e173.name: Cracking Stone
e173.text: Prerequisite: Calcification 3. Once per round, when a creature with Calcification 3+ is hit by an attack you did not make, you may use your reaction to shatter its calcifying shell: it sheds 1 Calcification and falls prone. This may spare an ally from petrification — or deny an enemy its stony armor — without spending your own attack.

e174.name: Swamp-Born
e174.text: You gain a swim speed equal to your walking speed and can hold your breath for 1 hour. While fully submerged, fire and radiant damage lose their cauterizing edge: a Neck Wound marked on a turn you end underwater cannot be cauterized until after your next turn begins, giving the regrowth time to root. As a bonus action while submerged, you may spend 1 CE to exhale venom-tinged murk into a 15-foot radius around you, heavily obscuring it until the start of your next turn.

e174.name: Guarding Heads
e174.text: When an adjacent ally is hit, spend 1 Head Die and reaction to reduce its damage by the die + CON modifier.

e174.name: Venom Reservoir
e174.text: A creature poisoned by your Hydra Venom also has its speed reduced by 10 feet. Your necks track the venom's spread through the victim's body: your Bite's reach extends by 5 feet against a poisoned creature, and when it tries to move away from you, you may spend 1 CE as a reaction to force a Strength saving throw — on a failure its movement ends immediately. The speed penalty and the leash both end when the poison ends.

e174.name: Heracles Problem
e174.text: When an enemy deals fire/radiant damage solely to cauterize a pending Neck Wound, gain one Head Die of temporary HP after that damage resolves.

e175.name: Weigh the Dead
e175.text: As an action and 2 CE, you may Weigh the heart of a corpse dead no more than 1 hour; it makes no save. You learn one significant burden it knowingly accepted in life — a bargain, betrayal, or sacrifice — as the GM describes. This offers no Temptations and adds no Heart Weight.

e175.name: Sweet Temptation
e175.text: Add Safety : when you or an ally within 30 feet would take damage from the Weighed creature, you may offer it Safety as a Temptation without spending an action (once per round). Accept: the damage is halved and it gains 1 Heart Weight. Refuse: the damage lands in full.

e175.name: Borrow the Burden
e175.text: When an ally within 30 feet accepts a Temptation, you may take the Heart Weight instead of them once per round. Temptations accepted by the hostile Weighed creature (such as Safety) do not trigger this feat — it covers allies’ acceptances only.

e175.name: Devour Excess
e175.text: When a 6-Weight creature spends 3+ CE, gain 1 temporary CE, maximum PB temporary CE, expiring after 1 minute. Temporary CE never raises your CE maximum.

e176.name: Iron Appetite
e176.text: While obeying Tyr’s Hand, healing you grant yourself through RCT is not prohibited, but costs +1 CE.

e176.name: Moon-Eater
e176.text: When Moon Chain breaks, you may use your reaction to bite the backlash: the creature whose action triggered the break takes 5 psychic damage as the snapped chain lashes through its overspent cursed energy.

e176.name: Slipped Leash
e176.text: When you succeed on a saving throw against a grapple, restraint, or forced-movement effect, you may use your reaction to move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks, slipping through the failed hold.

e176.name: Unbroken Oath
e176.text: If you complete an encounter without breaking a prepared Bond, choose one of your prepared Bonds. The next time that Bond’s trigger occurs, you may keep it unbroken instead of breaking it; you gain no Ragnarök from the ignored trigger.

e177.name: Ocean Coil
e177.text: Segments may be placed on water and you gain swim speed equal walking speed.

e177.name: Tail Around the Party
e177.text: Guard Rings grant allies advantage on saves against forced movement across their boundary.

e177.name: Venom of the World
e177.text: Poison immunity treats your Coil poison as resistance; poison resistance still functions normally.

e177.name: Closing Snap
e177.text: When a Segment you place completes a Ring, the circuit closes with a snap: one hostile creature of your choice inside the new Ring makes a Strength saving throw against your technique DC; on a failure it is pulled 10 feet toward the Ring’s center.

e178.name: Perfect Accent
e178.text: After listening to a language for 1 hour through a recorded Mask, you can reproduce its accent flawlessly but do not learn the language itself.

e178.name: Dinner Guest
e178.text: While impersonating someone inside a place where that identity is expected, gain advantage on checks to avoid casual scrutiny until you behave obviously out of character.

e178.name: Backward Hands
e178.text: Once per round, when you fail a Sleight of Hand or Deception check while masked, the Mask reads the room: you immediately learn which creatures that witnessed the check are suspicious of you.

e178.name: Predator’s Memory
e178.text: You can store one additional purely social Memory Note per Mask: a public relationship, routine, title, or preference you personally observed. It grants no secret knowledge.

e179.name: Rain-Bringer
e179.text: As an action and 1 CE, create light rain in a 30-foot radius for 10 minutes; it extinguishes mundane flame and gives advantage on Survival to find water.

e179.name: Jeweled Hood
e179.text: While at least one of your Coils is active, you sense the space around every Coil-bearing creature: you have blindsight to 10 feet centered on each creature bearing one of your Coils, and you cannot be surprised by a creature within that radius.

e179.name: Constriction Expert
e179.text: When a creature bearing one of your Constrict Coils would be forcibly moved, you can use your reaction to spend that Coil and anchor it in place, negating the movement entirely.

e179.name: Shared Skin
e179.text: As a bonus action, a willing creature bearing one of your Ward Coils can pass it to another willing creature within 30 feet; the Coil keeps its remaining duration.

e180.name: Fox Bridegroom
e180.text: Gain proficiency or expertise in Deception; harmless cosmetic shapechanging can alter hair, eyes, ears, tail, and clothing appearance at will.

e180.name: Blue Foxfire
e180.text: You may kindle a foxfire wisp in the space of one of your Paper Foxes. The first creature that becomes lured by that wisp regards you as a trusted ally while lured, hearing an ally’s voice calling from the flame.

e180.name: Clever Enough to Believe Yourself
e180.text: When you fail a save against being frightened or charmed, you may use your reaction and spend 1 CE to make one of your Paper Foxes within 30 feet believe the lie instead: the condition ends on you and the illusion is destroyed.

e180.name: Thousand-Year Trick
e180.text: Prerequisite: level 11. The first time each round a creature identifies one of your illusions, you may treat that wasted inspection as fuel: it counts as a deception that wasted an action for the purpose of claiming your next lie.

e181.name: Bone Chime
e181.text: You can sense creatures below half HP within 30 feet if they have bones or a comparable internal structure.

e181.name: Graveyard Architecture
e181.text: Torso of a Nation may anchor to terrain and counts as a structure for allies using cover or climbing.

e181.name: Starving Maw
e181.text: When you would take starvation damage for ending your turn at Hunger cap, you may instead force one creature grappled by your Jaw to take that damage as necrotic, your manifested skeleton gnawing through its own hunger. The grapple continues.

e181.name: Jaw of Famine
e181.text: As a bonus action while a creature is grappled by your Jaw, you may end the grapple to feed: gain 1 Hunger and temporary HP equal to 5.

e182.name: Zal’s Feather
e182.text: Once per long rest, when a creature within 30 feet would fall to 0 HP, consume any Feather to leave it at 1 HP instead. This cannot prevent instant death that does not reduce HP.

e182.name: Scholar of Ages
e182.text: Gain proficiency or expertise in History or Medicine. A Skill Feather may be spent on either of those skills regardless of how it was created.

e182.name: Carry the Young
e182.text: While flying, you may carry one willing creature of your size or smaller without reducing your speed.

e182.name: Memory of Fire
e182.text: When a willing creature within 60 feet fails a save against fire, fear, or death effects, you may use your reaction and spend 1 CE to record the moment of survival: create one Resolve Feather immediately (once per round, still subject to your cap).

e183.name: Polyphonic Horror
e183.text: failing saves against two different Typhon phenomena in one round can frighten until end next turn.

e183.name: Tireless Coils
e183.text: +10 speed; standing costs 5 ft; advantage vs forced movement while transformed.

e183.name: Volcanic Prison
e183.text: grappled target takes one die fire when it willingly teleports/escapes.

e183.name: Last Challenge of Olympus (11+)
e183.text: first time/long rest below one-quarter HP, immediately gain PB Cataclysm.

e184.name: Jailor of Titans
e184.text: remote grapple costs one fewer Hand, minimum 2.

e184.name: Catch the Sky
e184.text: defensive Hand reaction can protect against ranged technique attacks from 30 ft.

e184.name: Briarean Barrage (11+)
e184.text: Stone Barrage may hit same target three times; third hit gets no CE modifier.

e185.name: Appraiser's Eye
e185.text: quickly assess value, CE presence and curse signs.

e185.name: Jealous Wings
e185.text: at 3+ Greed in Wyrm Shape gain 30-ft flight.

e185.name: No Thief Escapes
e185.text: Dragon's Claim reaction movement becomes full speed once/round.

e185.name: Accursed Gold (11+)
e185.text: carriers of stolen Hoard Marks have disadvantage on saves against your technique.

e186.name: Burial Goods
e186.text: maintain a second portable Anchor; only one projects Mound.

e186.name: Corpse Weight
e186.text: count one size larger for carrying/grapple/forced movement while swollen.

e186.name: Unquiet Dead (11+)
e186.text: Too Angry to Die also ends frightened and charmed.

e187.name: Winged Escort
e187.text: carry one willing creature while flying without speed penalty.

e187.name: Shieldmaiden
e187.text: Ride to Fallen may impose disadvantage instead of damage reduction.

e187.name: Last Seat in Valhalla (11+)
e187.text: once/long rest record a Deed when ally fails a death save.

e188.name: Footprints Vanish
e188.text: no mundane snow tracks; advantage Stealth in cold terrain.

e188.name: Kiss of Winter
e188.text: Warmth Stolen through grapple adds one die.

e188.name: Snowblind
e188.text: creatures at 2+ Frost have disadvantage on sight Perception against you.

e188.name: First Flurry (6+)
e188.text: on initiative place a free 10-ft Snowfield patch through end of round.

e189.name: Dread Laugh
e189.text: Black failed save also removes reactions against you.

e189.name: Parade Master (11+)
e189.text: silhouettes gain HP equal to level instead of 1.

e190.name: Tremor Reader
e190.text: while touching thread, blindsight 10 ft around connected anchors.

e190.name: Spider Drop
e190.text: first melee hit after descending from ceiling +1 die.

e190.name: Eightfold Knot (11+)
e190.text: once/short rest Loom Trap needs only 2 anchors.

e191.name: Monkey's Cunning
e191.text: proficiency/expertise in Sleight of Hand while Monkey is active.

e191.name: Tiger's Pounce
e191.text: Tiger hit after 15-ft approach can knock prone on Str fail.

e191.name: Serpent's Patience
e191.text: sustained grapple can become restrained after contested action.

e191.name: Tanuki Mist
e191.text: Hide while lightly obscured in Tanuki Aspect.

e192.name: Feather Shield
e192.text: reaction spend Pinion for +2 AC to ally within 15 ft.

e192.name: Sky Ferry
e192.text: carry one willing creature without flight penalty.

e192.name: Venom Breaker
e192.text: Enemy of Venom can apply to disease/corrosive ongoing effects when appropriate.

e193.name: Enemy of Sunrise
e193.text: when radiant lowers Depth gain PB temp HP once/round.

e193.name: Chaos Before Creation (11+)
e193.text: once/long rest when Depth would hit 0, keep it at 1.

e194.name: Red Beer Ritual
e194.text: use Draught on adjacent ally; your Heat still falls.

e194.name: Two Faces of the Sun (11+)
e194.text: switch Maximum mode once during its duration.

e195.name: Lantern Eyes
e195.text: Head darkvision 120 and sees invisible within 10 ft.

e195.name: Unbroken Gallop
e195.text: forced movement toward Road's End can generate Gallop once/round.

e195.name: Death Coach
e195.text: Steed carries one ally and shares movement.

e195.name: Last Name Spoken (11+)
e195.text: once/long rest Name on Road can mark two, though only one gets bonus damage.

e196.name: Family Wail
e196.text: Choose PB allies after each long rest; your keen’s witness range extends to 90 feet for them.

e196.name: Glass-Shattering Keen
e196.text: Wail deals double damage to fragile mundane objects.

e196.name: Professional Mourner
e196.text: When a creature you keen for dies, you regain 1 CE. Once per short rest.

e196.name: Second Cry (11+)
e196.text: When the keen fires, one additional hostile within range must save against its frighten.

e197.name: Long Arms
e197.text: While transformed, you may use your bonus action to plant Blight with your long arms: touch a point within your reach to create a 5-foot Blight patch there for 1 minute.

e197.name: Murrain Wind
e197.text: When you take the Dash action while transformed, you may exhale your breath behind you, leaving a 5-foot-wide trail of Blight along your path until the start of your next turn.

e197.name: Salt-Air Rot
e197.text: As a bonus action, you can taste the Wither on a creature within 30 feet that has at least 2 Wither: learn its current HP total and whether it is maintaining Focus on anything.

e197.name: Black Tide (11+)
e197.text: once/short rest move one Blight patch 10 ft, never across fresh water.

e198.name: Roost Walker
e198.text: You gain a climb speed equal to your walking speed and can hang hands-free from any surface you could climb, talons and tail holding you fast. While hanging hands-free and unseen, From the Sound applies to every attack you make that turn, not just the first. Releasing your grip deliberately is silent: you have advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks to land unheard when you drop on purpose.

e198.name: Blood Echo
e198.text: A bloodied creature moving within 30 feet of one of your Echo nodes leaves a sound-track you can follow until the end of your next turn.

e198.name: Silent Wing
e198.text: When you use Razor Swoop, your passage stays unrevealed until the attack resolves: you are treated as unseen for the swoop's attack, and enemies cannot use reactions triggered by your movement during it. Creatures that had not perceived you before the swoop do not learn your location until after damage is rolled. If the attack misses, you may immediately Swap to an Echo node within 30 feet as part of the same action, gone on the wingbeat.

e198.name: Vanishing Wing (11+)
e198.text: When you are hit by an attack, you may use your reaction and spend 1 CE to swap with an Echo node within 30 feet; the attack misses if your new position is beyond the attacker's reach or out of its line of sight.

e199.name: Precious Plumes
e199.text: When you generate a Plume from a full traversal, you may instead immediately redraw one of your Wind Roads, keeping its length but choosing a new position and direction anchored within 30 feet of you.

e199.name: Tailwind Archer
e199.text: When you make a ranged attack along the direction of a Wind Road, you may have the attack emerge from a Crossroad within 60 feet of you instead, originating there and ignoring cover between you and the target.

e199.name: Cloud Serpent
e199.text: While flying with Serpent of the Updraft, you may use a bonus action to trace a Wind Road up to 30 feet long along your flight path. It counts against your normal maximum.

e199.name: Four Directions (11+)
e199.text: When you or a willing ally teleports between Crossroads, you may instead swap the positions of two willing creatures standing at two different Crossroads within range.

e200.name: Inscribed Gate
e200.text: When you inscribe a Threshold, you may spend 1 Vigilance to render it invisible to hostile creatures. A hostile creature can spot it with a successful Wisdom (Perception) check against your technique save DC.

e200.name: Winged Guardian
e200.text: When you use Bull-Lion Intercession, you may instead teleport the ally from one Threshold to another Threshold within 30 feet of the first, rather than swapping positions with them; you still take the hit either way.

e200.name: Palace Watch
e200.text: As a bonus action, you may spend 2 Vigilance to relocate one Threshold you can see to a new valid anchor within 60 feet.

e200.name: No Unrecorded Passage (11+)
e200.text: Hostile invisible creatures that cross one of your Thresholds are revealed until the end of their turn: invisibility and similar concealment are suppressed for the crossing creature as the gate counts its passage. The creature may attempt a Wisdom save against your technique DC; on a success it remains unseen but still generates Vigilance as normal. You always know the exact space where the crossing occurred. This revelation pierces magical invisibility but not total cover or anti-divination effects.

e201.name: Cedar Warden
e201.text: The forest carries your face farther and wider. Your active Terror Face's aura effects now originate from a 20-foot radius around each cedar zone within 120 feet of you (instead of 15 feet within 60 feet). Your own 15-foot personal aura is unchanged.

e201.name: Terrible Countenance
e201.text: When a Cedar zone is destroyed, you may immediately switch your Face without using an action and resolve the new Face against the creature that destroyed it.

e201.name: Forest Voice
e201.text: Switching your Terror Face is not a verbal act: you may change Faces even while silenced, gagged, or inside magical silence — and while you cannot speak, switching your Face costs no action at all. The forest speaks where your voice cannot.

e201.name: Sevenfold Guardian (11+)
e201.text: Once per short rest, when you switch your Terror Face, you may maintain two Faces simultaneously until the end of your next turn — your visage splits and both fear-laws hold. Hostiles in your Aura resolve both Faces' effects where applicable, but a single creature cannot suffer more than one failed-save result from this overlap. When the duration ends, you keep the most recently chosen Face and the other fades.

e202.name: Compound Payload
e202.text: When you spend 2 Spines on a single Tail Volley attack, you may combine two payload effects on that attack, such as a Barbed Venom quill, instead of choosing only one.

e202.name: Scorpion Tail
e202.text: You may deliver your Venom payload through your Lion’s Maw instead of a quill. When you hit with Lion’s Maw, you may spend 1 Spine to force the target to make the Venom saving throw.

e202.name: Quill Catcher
e202.text: Once per round, when a ranged weapon attack misses you, you may use your reaction to snatch the projectile from the air and add it to your Tail Magazine, recovering 1 Spine. If you do, you may immediately make a Tail Volley attack against a creature within range without spending a Spine, firing the caught missile back. This return shot follows the normal Tail Volley rules but cannot apply payload effects.

e202.name: Hunter's Mouth
e202.text: When you hit an object or a dead or incapacitated creature with Lion’s Maw, you recover 2 Spines instead of 1.

e243.name: Dialed In
e243.text: Increase Active Playlist capacity by 2, never beyond the number of Subjugated ordinary forms. When a mistransformation roll is required, roll twice and choose either result. Once per short rest when you gain Instability, reduce the amount gained by 1, minimum 0.

e243.name: Hero Time
e243.text: Once per short rest, use one of these triggers: when initiative is rolled, immediately transform into a loaded ordinary form without an action or CE; or when a creature you can see within 30 feet is targeted by an attack, use your reaction to transform for 0 CE before the attack resolves. The second option does not redirect the attack or grant a second reaction.

e243.name: Quick-Change Combatant
e243.text: The first Quick Change you make in a round adds no Instability. Beginning at level 15, whenever Precision Dial would already prevent that Instability, you may instead move 10 feet without provoking after the change and add 1 OD to the next natural-weapon hit you make before the turn ends.

e243.name: Form Specialist
e243.text: Choose one Subjugated non-Way Big form. Choose one specialty for it: Armor grants +1 Alien AC; Force adds 1 OD to one natural-weapon hit on each of your turns; or Efficiency reduces the CE cost of one printed 1–3 CE form feature by 1 once on each of your turns, minimum 1 CE. You may take this feat again for another form, but never twice for the same form.

e244.name: Fast Scribe
e244.text: Once per turn, you may inscribe a Tier I rune as a bonus action instead of an action.

e244.name: Blood-Carved Staves
e244.text: You may carve a persistent rune directly into your own flesh as a living stave. A rune carved this way moves with you, cannot be dispelled by effects that target objects, and once per short rest you may invoke it as a bonus action instead of an action.

e244.name: Ætt-Binder
e244.text: When you form a Bindrune from two runes of the same ætt, you may inscribe it on a weapon, shield, or tool you touch. Either component rune can then be invoked separately without breaking the Bindrune. Wyrd belongs to no ætt and can never benefit from this feat.

e244.name: Runeseer
e244.text: Reading of the Three takes 1 minute instead of 10. Its Foretold Die becomes your Rune Die. Once per long rest, you may ask one simple yes/no question concerning the next 24 hours; the GM answers truthfully according to the most likely course of events at the time of the reading.

e246.name: Lasting Laughs
e246.text: Even when you’re the one telling the joke, you can’t stop laughing. For an additional 2 CE when you activate Comedy, you can make the technique last 10 minutes. This does not work with Peak Comedy.

e246.name: Super Gag
e246.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Commit to the Bit
e246.text: You have stepped up your game with some premium material you read online. You gain the following gags while your technique is active: Written on your Face. As an action for 3 CE, you target a creature within 30 ft that you can see. For 1 minute or when your technique ends, the target’s emotions and intentions are literally written on their face. The target has disadvantage on attacks against anyone who can see their face. Anyone that can see their face knows their general emotions and can tell whenever they are scheming or planning something by reading the doodles on their face. Costume Switch. As an action for 2 CE, you apply a wardrobe change to a number of creatures equal to your CE modifier within 30 ft of you that you can see. This effect is purely cosmetic and cannot change their AC or movement and cannot give them any conditions. You can also change a property about them, such as giving them multiple eyes or arms. These changes are nonfunctional and a creature can take an action to make a Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) against your CE save DC inspect these changes. On a success, they realize the changes are fake. This feature lasts for a number of minutes equal to your CE modifier before disappearing.

e246.name: Maximum: Laugh Track
e246.text: As a bonus action for 3 CE while your technique is active, you summon an invisible audience around you. For the next minute, creatures within 30 ft have disadvantage on saves against your techniques and you have advantage on ability checks and saves to maintain your technique.

e247.name: Bestial Seance
e247.text: You have learned to bring a bit of whimsy to your usually ghastly technique. When you use Seance on yourself, you can choose to instead channel the Physical Information of a Beast with a CR equal to or less than your proficiency bonus. You gain all the creature’s traits, senses, movements and actions in addition to the normal effects of Physical Information. To use this technique, you must be wearing a costume of that specific animal, costing $200 x the Beast’s CR. You can wear this costume with armor, but if it takes an amount of damage (other than psychic) equal to 3 x your level, it becomes unusable and you lose any benefits from this feature.

e247.name: Perfect Ritual
e247.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Ritual of Resurrection
e247.text: You won’t allow anyone to interrupt your seance. You have advantage on saving throws to maintain concentration for your Seance technique and the time to complete your Ritual is decreased to 3 rounds. Additionally, you decrease the saving throw DC a target makes against the dead humanoid’s Soul Information by your CE modifier.

e247.name: Cling to Life
e247.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Black Seance
e247.text: When a target runs out of cursed energy and can no longer maintain the seance, they can choose to forcefully hold the spirit within their body. At the beginning of the target’s turn, they instead spend 5 HP, reducing their maximum by the same amount. Your hit point maximum is restored by 15 after each long rest.

e248.name: Blood Production
e248.text: You have found a way to link your blood to Cursed Energy. For 1 CE, you can create a sufficient source of blood worth 10 HP that can only be used for your Rot features. This does not regain HP.

e248.name: Condensed Decay
e248.text: You have learned to increase the potency of your blood’s properties. When you use a Rot Technique, you can spend additional HP up to twice your CE modifier to increase the damage dice of acid dealt by your technique by one tier for every 2 HP spent (d8<d10<d12) to a max of d12.

e248.name: Blackened Blood
e248.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Wing King
e248.text: Your blood has become bubbling and black. A creature that fails a Constitution saving throw against your technique by 5 or more gains a level of exhaustion. A creature cannot gain more than 3 levels of exhaustion from this feature.

e248.name: Wing King Improvement
e248.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Wing King
e248.text: You have mastered your Maximum technique, granting you the following benefits while using Wing King: you gain the Evasion feature; you can now make four lines of blood attacks as a free action on your turn; you can use a Rot Technique as a bonus action.

e249.name: Expert Maker
e249.prereq: Prerequisite: Must make Cursed Corpse Creation
e249.text: You have spent your life learning your technique and learned tips and tricks that help you master the process. You can create a cursed core or body for 1/3 of the cost or time.

e249.name: Soul Imbuement
e249.prereq: Prerequisites: Must have Cursed Corpse Creation
e249.text: You have learned to copy a creature’s soul information into a Cursed Corpse. You can only have 1 soul imbued corpse at a time. This increases to 2 at 11th level and 3 at 18th level. It takes 3 long rests to imbue someone’s soul information into the core. You must have the person readily available or have a good memory of the person to turn their physical information into soul information. Once a corpse has been created, it takes 2 weeks to develop before it becomes sentient. It gains the Autonomy mutation and can choose a Cursed Energy feat as if it were a player. A corpse with this core is sentient and mimics the behavior of the soul they are imbued with, but it does not gain its memories.

e249.name: Cursed Tactician
e249.text: When you use Corpse Tactics, you can spend ce up to your proficiency bonus to use an additional tactics option for each ce spent. You can choose the same tactics option as part of the same bonus action, but you cannot use the same tactics multiple times on the same cursed corpse.

e249.name: Mutate Specialist
e249.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Corpse Mutation
e249.text: You have learned the process to purposely force mutations to occur. When you roll for a mutation, you can add your Cursed Energy modifier to the roll. If you succeed, you roll for an additional mutation for every number higher than 20. You cannot gain the same mutation more than once.

e250.name: Blood Production
e250.text: You have found a way to link your blood to Cursed Energy. For 1 CE, you can create a sufficient source of blood worth 10 HP that can only be used for your Blood Manipulation features. This does not regain HP.

e250.name: Poisonous Blood
e250.text: Your blood has grown to be harmful to others. If you hit a creature by 5 or more than their AC or a creature fails a save against a Blood Manipulation technique by 5 or more, the target is poisoned for 1 minute. They can make a Constitution save at the end of their turn to cure the condition.

e250.name: Blood Crystallization
e250.text: You gain the ability to harden your blood to a solid, even if it risks thrombosis and further increases your versatility. As a bonus action for 3 CE. you gain the following for 1 minute: as a reaction, you can add a +5 to your AC against an attack; your unarmed damage dice increases by two levels (d8<d10<d12<2d8); you gain resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage. At the end of your turn, roll a d20. On a 2 or lower you gain a level of exhaustion.

e250.name: Flowing Red Scale: Stack
e250.prereq: Prerequisites: Must have Flowing Red Scale
e250.text: The power of the Flowing Red Scale has reached new heights. As a bonus action for 6 CE or while Flowing Red Scale is active for 3 CE, you instead gain the following benefits for 1 minute: your movement speed is tripled; you gain a +4 bonus to AC; you have advantage on Dexterity and Strength saving throws and Strength checks and once per round you can reroll a check or save; you gain one extra action and reaction.

e250.name: Supernova
e250.text: You can create small orbs of condensed blood that explode like a buckshot. As an action, you condense your Piercing Blood into a tiny orb of blood in an unoccupied space that you can see within 30 feet, which stays there for a maximum of 1 minute before exploding. You can create as many orbs as your proficiency bonus in an action with each having its own cost, spending 5 CE and 5 HP for each, and can choose for them to explode immediately upon creation or manually as a reaction to a creature entering the range of explosion. The orb then explodes, forcing every creature within 10 feet of it to make a Dexterity saving throw for each orb. On a failure, the target takes 8d8 piercing damage and is knocked prone. On a success, they take half as much damage and aren’t knocked prone.

e250.name: Wing King Imitation
e250.text: You condense your blood into wings resembling veins as a bonus action for 10 CE, gathering the wings behind you and gaining the following benefits for 1 minute: your walking speed is quadrupled; you gain a flying speed equal to half your walking speed; as a free action on your turn, you can unleash lines of blood. This takes shape as three ranged Cursed Energy attacks against a creature within 60 feet. Each attack deals 3d10 + your CE modifier in necrotic damage. While using Wing King, you cannot use Piercing Blood.

e251.name: Aerokinesis
e251.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Storms of Disaster
e251.text: Through training and understanding, you have found new applications for your storms. You gain the one of the following (You can select this feat multiple times): Suffocation. As an action for 2 cursed energy, you target a creature within 30 ft that you can see. They must make a Constitution saving throw, taking your proficiency bonus in d6s of necrotic damage and start suffocating on a failed save. While suffocating their movement is halved and their attack rolls have disadvantage. If you are more than 30 ft away or lose concentration, the target stops suffocating. Resistance to lightning and thunder damage.

e251.name: Flying Nimbus
e251.text: While using Storm Creation, you have a flying speed equal to your walking speed and can hover. When you use Storms of Disaster while flying, you can immediately move up to 10 ft without spending movement or provoking opportunity attacks.

e251.name: Squall
e251.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Divine Storm Sovereign
e251.text: While you are within a storm of your creation, your movement speed increases by 20 ft and you can teleport to a different point within the storm as a bonus action. Additionally when you are reduced to 0 hit points, you can instead melt into storms and reconstitute your form at a different point within the storm at 1 hit point. Once you reconstitute your body using this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest.

e252.name: Reinforced Vermin
e252.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Vermin of Disaster
e252.text: As part of the bonus action you take to command your Insect Swarms, you can spend 2 cursed energy to reinforce one of your Insect Swarms with cursed energy for 1 minute. While reinforced, their size category increases by one and they deal an additional 2 damage dice on a successful Bites attack (only +1 if bloodied). If you use multiple Reinforced Insect Swarms to form a Vermin Swarm, it only gains these benefits once.

e252.name: Vermin Techniques
e252.text: You have learned to better control the combined actions of your Vermin Swarms, allowing you to learn the following ways to use your Swarms: Insect Cloak. While you are occupying the same space as one of your Vermin Swarms, you can treat the Swarm's hit points as temporary hit points for yourself. Grasping Hand. You can spend 3 CE to replace one of your attacks on your turn with a grapple check through one of your Insect Swarms against a creature within 5 ft of the swarm. Instead of an Athletics check, you make a Cursed Energy (Arcana) check. The grapple gains a +1 bonus and +5 ft of range per size category above Medium the swarm is. On a success, the creature is grappled and can be pulled into the Insect Swarm. Transport Via Bugs. As an action for 6 CE, you form a link between one Large or larger Vermin Swarm within 10 ft and connect it to another Large or larger Vermin Swarm at any distance. Before the end of your turn, you can spend 5 ft of movement to walk into the space of the Insect Swarm within 5 ft, reappearing within 5 ft of the destination Insect Swarm.

e252.name: Festering Life Sword
e252.text: As a bonus action for 6 CE, you transform a weapon you are holding. It loses all previous benefits and becomes the Special Grade Cursed Tool: Festering Life Sword. You can only have one weapon transformed this way at a time and this tool disappears when you finish a long rest or die.

e253.name: Levitation System
e253.text: As an action for 2 CE, you can cast Levitate. You can spend an additional 2 CE to force the creature to make the save at disadvantage.

e253.name: Dense Antigravity Shield
e253.text: For an additional 3 CE, your Antigravity Shield instead reduces all damage against you by half your Antigravity's maximum height fall damage dice until the beginning of your next turn.

e253.name: Antigravitational Flight
e253.text: As an action for 3 CE, you can give yourself or another creature you touch a 60 feet hover speed for 10 minutes.

e254.name: Instant Manifestation
e254.text: You have learned a trick to instantly deploy your technique. Creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against being trapped by your Dark Cube and you can create a Dark Cube around yourself as a reaction to being hit with an attack, causing it to take the damage in your stead. If you take the dodge action on your turn, you can also use this reaction to create a 10 feet cube around yourself and another creature within 5 feet.

e254.name: Offensive Creations
e254.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Black Box Reinforcement
e254.text: You have focused on using your technique to devastating effects and have learned offensive applications of your cursed technique: Crushing Cube. As an action for 4 CE, you target a 30 feet tall, 10 feet wide square cylinder within 30 feet. All creatures in range must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure they take 5d10 necrotic damage and fall prone as they are crushed under a massive Dark Cube. On a success, they take half as much damage and are not prone. Block Strike. As a bonus action for 2 CE, you cover your fist or other part of your body with a Dark Cube for 1 minute. You can make a melee cursed energy attack with your unarmed strikes. On a hit you deal your proficiency bonus in d4s + your CE modifier in necrotic damage. Dark Press. As an action for 5 CE, you can create a Dark Cube in front of you that explodes in length on one side. All creatures in a 10 feet wide 60 feet long line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 6d8 necrotic damage and are pushed back to the edge of the line. If they impact a solid object or structure, they take the remaining distance as fall damage.

e254.name: Sealing Cube
e254.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Maximum: Midnight Armor
e254.text: When you trap a creature in a Perfect Cube, you can choose to seal the output of the creature. They can only spend the minimum cursed energy on a cursed technique while trapped within your Perfect Cube and cannot use cursed techniques that cost more than 5 cursed energy.

e255.name: Ferocious Courage
e255.text: Once per turn, you can choose to deal additional fire damage equal to your proficiency bonus.

e255.name: Blazing Heart
e255.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Mantle of Courage
e255.text: When you use Mantle of Courage, all creatures of your choice in range gain 5 temporary hit points and again at the start of your turn for the duration.

e255.name: Soulfire
e255.text: You have learned to burn even the soul. When you hit with a melee attack, you can spend 3 CE to cause all fire damage dealt on your turn to ignore immunity to fire damage and reduce a creature's maximum hit points until they complete a long rest.

e255.name: Technique Release
e255.text: When you hit with an attack while Ignition is activated, you can release the technique, ending the effects of Ignition on the weapon in exchange for doubling your fire damage for this attack. If used with Maximum: Conflagration, it instead deals a number of additional damage die equal to the CE spent on Ignition.

e256.name: Dowsing Vibrations
e256.text: While your centipede shikigami is summoned, you gain 100 ft tremorsense while both of your feet are on the ground. You gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls against creatures who are within your tremorsense (must be touching the ground). This increases to 150 ft at 6th level, 200 ft at 11th, and 300 ft at 18th level.

e256.name: Wu Gong
e256.text: You have learned to concentrate the venom of your cursed centipede and add it to your attacks. When you or your centipede hit with a melee attack, you can spend 1 CE to force the creature to make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes your proficiency in d6s of poison damage and they are stunned until the beginning of their next turn.

e256.name: Centipede Festival
e256.text: Through your bond with your shikigami, you have learned of its hunger for both flesh and battle, improving your teamwork even more: when you or your centipede kill a creature within 5 ft, your centipede partially devours the corpse and regains hit points equal to your level + your CE modifier. At 11th level, your centipede can also feast on its cursed energy (unless it has none), causing you to regain 1 cursed energy. You can spend 1 CE as a bonus action or as part of summoning it to give it temporary hit points equal to twice your level.

e257.name: Forcible Confession
e257.text: As a bonus action for 2 CE, you can force a creature within 30 ft to speak only truthful words for 1 minute, or until they succeed on a Charisma saving throw at the end of their turn.

e257.name: Cunning Judicator
e257.text: When a creature breaks a Binding Vow with you, you can spend 5 CE as a reaction to force the creature to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they take 1d4 per remaining hit point of force damage.

e258.name: Circuit Trap Expert
e258.text: You have become an expert at setting circuit traps. The saving throw DC for your circuit patterns increases by 2, and creatures have disadvantage on saving throws against being restrained by your Stasis Hold pattern.

e258.name: Circuit Chain Reaction
e258.text: When a circuit pattern is activated, you can spend 2 cursed energy to cause a chain reaction. Choose a circuit pattern within 20 feet of the activated pattern. That pattern is also activated, even if its activation condition is not met. You can use this feature a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per long rest.

e258.name: Living Circuitry
e258.text: You have learned to infuse your own body with cursed circuitry. As an action, you can spend 10 cursed energy to gain the following benefits for 1 minute: your unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d6 lightning damage; you gain resistance to lightning damage; you can use Burst Leap on yourself as a bonus action without needing a circuit pattern. At 11th level, you can spend 15 cursed energy instead to also gain immunity to being stunned.

e259.name: Master Alchemist
e259.text: You have mastered the art of transmutation. You can now transmute magical objects, and you can transmute objects as an action instead of a bonus action.

e259.name: Philosopher's Stone
e259.text: You have created a Philosopher's Stone, a powerful alchemical artifact. While you possess it, you gain the following benefits: you have advantage on saving throws against poison; you are immune to disease; when you use Healing Transmutation, you can grant the target temporary hit points equal to half the amount healed.

e259.name: Soul Alchemy
e259.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Alchemy of the Soul
e259.text: You have learned to transmute souls. As an action for 8 CE, you can forge a soul bond with a willing creature within 30 ft. While bonded, you can sense each other's emotions and location, and you can communicate telepathically. If one of you takes damage, the other can choose to take half of that damage instead. This bond lasts until dispelled or until one of you dies.

e260.name: Wheel of Adaptation
e260.text: You manifest a wheel above your head that tracks your adaptations. When you use Adaptation, you can choose to adapt to two damage types instead of one.

e260.name: Mahoraga's Fury
e260.text: When you are reduced to half your hit points or fewer, you can unleash Mahoraga's fury. For 1 minute, your unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d10 slashing damage, and you have advantage on saving throws against being frightened.

e260.name: Perfect Adaptation
e260.text: Your adaptation is now perfect. When you use Adaptation, the resistance or immunity lasts for 10 minutes instead of 1 minute.

e261.name: Ley Line Extension
e261.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Ley Line Command
e261.text: You have learned to extend the benefits of your connection with the earth to others. When you create a Ley Line you can give a number of creatures equal to your Cursed Energy modifier the benefits of Flow of the Dragon while they are within 30 ft and touching the same ground as you.

e261.name: Ground Control
e261.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Earth Dragon Soul
e261.text: As an action for 3 CE, you stomp your foot and transform the ground within 30 ft in one of the following ways:

e262.name: Density Manipulation
e262.text: You have learned to increase the density of your stone creations. The amount of hit points each cube created by your Excavation now equals 10 times your CE modifier. Stone constructs created by your other Innate Technique features gain an additional 10 hit points.

e262.name: Rock Burst
e262.text: As a reaction, you can cause one of your stone constructs within 60 feet of you to explode. Any creature within 5 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, they take 1d12 bludgeoning damage and are knocked prone. You can spend CE up to half your proficiency bonus (rounded down) as part of this reaction to heighten the explosion and deal an additional 1d12 bludgeoning damage per CE and cause creatures in range to take half as much damage on a success.

e262.name: Arms of the Giant
e262.text: You are no longer required to maintain concentration to maintain your Stone Arms. Additionally, while spending 1 CE each turn to maintain your hands, you are able to control your Stone Arms as if casting the spell Bigby's Hand. A creature that gains the restrained condition from your Stone Arms has their movement speed halved for 1 minute or until they regain hit points.

e263.name: Snake Scales
e263.text: As an action for 4 cursed energy, you summon the scales of Yamata no Orochi to protect your flesh. Your AC cannot be lower than 14 + your proficiency bonus and you become resistant to poison and slashing damage for 1 hour.

e263.name: Blessing of the Hydra
e263.text: When you use Eight Lives to return to life, you can gain resistance to one damage type that reduced you to 0 hit points or immunity to one harmful condition you had. This benefit lasts for 1 hour.

e263.name: Fang Versatility
e263.prereq: Prerequisites: Must have Fangs of Orochi
e263.text: You have trained your technique to be more versatile in combat. You can wield Fangs or Orochi as a Dagger or Shortsword. On a hit with this weapon, a creature must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the creature takes an additional 2d6 poison damage and is poisoned until the end of their next turn. Your Fang Shikigami gain the following improvements:

e263.name: Incarnation
e263.text: Once you have used Sacrifice to gain all eight heads, the tattoos come together to form a knot on your chest. As a Full-Turn Action (Action + Bonus Action + Movement), you can complete the ritual and incarnate the Special Grade Cursed Spirit: Yamata no Orochi as a shikigami in an unoccupied space within 10 ft of you.

e264.name: Diptych
e264.text: You have learned to fold, expand, and even connect the subspaces of your paintings. When you enter one of your painting subspaces, you can spend 4 cursed energy to exit from one of your physical paintings. Additionally, the number of paintings you can have at once increases by your proficiency bonus and the area of your subspace doubles.

e264.name: Air Brush
e264.text: Once per turn when you take the Attack action, you can spend 1 cursed energy to replace one of your attacks on your turn with an attack from a Giant Ink Shikigami. Make a melee cursed energy attack against a creature you can see within 30 ft. You create a painting of cursed energy and one of your Ink Shikigami attacks from the painting, dealing 3d10 + your CE modifier necrotic damage on a hit. This increases to 4d10 at 6th level and 5d10 at 11th level.

e264.name: Gradient
e264.text: Alternatively, instead of using your innate technique features within Gradient, you can instead enhance your spatial awareness. You gain advantage on attack rolls against creatures within the subspace. While Gradient is active, you can use your reaction to add your CE modifier to an attack roll, saving throw, or AC against one attack roll. While using Gradient this way, you cannot use Impasto Canvas.

e265.name: Reduced Harm
e265.text: You have learned to minimize the damage you take when using your technique. You decrease the hit point loss from using any part of your body as an explosive by an amount equal to your Constitution modifier (minimum 1 hit point). At 6th level, this reduction increases to an amount equal to twice your Constitution modifier plus your level (minimum 1 hit point).

e265.name: Elemental Bomb
e265.text: You have learned how to create different types of explosions, making them create different effects. You can spend additional cursed energy equal to the energy spent in using the bomb to make them an elemental bomb. The elemental bomb will deal additional dice of fire, cold or lightning damage, equal to the original bombs' damage.

e266.name: Kinetic Absorption
e266.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Store and Release
e266.text: As a reaction to bludgeoning, slashing, or piercing damage, you can spend 1 cursed energy to reduce the incoming damage by your Cursed Energy score and gain 1 Jin Charge. You cannot reduce the damage of other damage types.

e266.name: Instantaneous Charge
e266.text: When you use at least 3 Jin charges for Instantaneous Movement, you gain advantage on your next melee attack roll. On a hit, you deal additional thunder damage equal to your Cursed Energy modifier.

e267.name: Veil of the Faceless God
e267.text: You have learned to use the power of the Faceless God to protect yourself. As a reaction to taking psychic damage, you can spend 3 cursed energy to gain resistance to psychic damage until the end of your next turn. Additionally, while this resistance is active, you gain a +1 bonus to all saving throws.

e267.name: Hands of Madness
e267.text: You have learned to use your Madness to enhance your unarmed strikes. You gain 1d6 Madness when you hit a creature with an unarmed strike. Additionally, your unarmed strikes deal an additional 1d6 psychic damage for every 10 Madness the target has.

e267.name: True Mania
e267.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Obsession and Insanity
e267.text: You have learned to use your madness to its fullest potential. When a creature becomes berserk, they gain an additional 1 level of exhaustion. Additionally, when you become berserk, you gain an additional 1d6 psychic damage on all your attacks.

e268.name: Destined One
e268.text: You or the DM chooses one creature you touch as your Destined One. You can always tell where your Destined One is as the thread of Fate always guides your hand. While within 30 ft of your Destined One, you have advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened. Additionally, once per round you can add your proficiency bonus to your AC against an attack roll made against you or to a saving throw you make, potentially changing the outcome. You cannot change the creature chosen as your Destined One unless they die.

e268.name: Web of Fate
e268.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Cursed Eyes of Fate
e268.text: When you cast a Fate onto targets, you can instead target a number of creatures equal to 1 + your proficiency bonus within range. If the Fate requires Touch, you must touch all targets of the technique.

e268.name: Maximum: Shears of Three Fates
e268.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Road of Karma
e268.text: As an action for 15 cursed energy, you form a scissor with your fingers and snip one of the threads of fate of a creature you can see within 5 ft of you. At the start of each of the target’s turns, they must make a Death save. This roll cannot have advantage or disadvantage and the target gains 1 level of exhaustion for every failed death save. If the target fails 3 death saves, they fall to 0 hit points and die. They are unable to be revived by cursed techniques. If the target succeeds 3 death saves or you are reduced to 0 hit points or die, the technique ends and the target becomes immune to this technique for 3 days.

e269.name: Greater Foresight
e269.text: Your foresight ability has reached even greater potential, reaching the point some consider enlightened. Whenever you have advantage because of your technique, you can roll 3 dice instead of 2 and keep the highest roll. Also, whenever a creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you because of your technique, they roll 3 dice instead of 2 and keep the lowest roll.

e269.name: GG True Warstaff
e269.text: You have created a more powerful version of your G Warstaff, being a true weapon of destruction. As a bonus action while you have G Warstaff active, you can spend 4 cursed energy to evolve it into its true form, GG True Warstaff. It gains the following benefits for 1 minute: it deals one additional damage dice; its reach is 15 ft instead of 10 ft; when you score a critical hit against a creature, you gain 2 seconds instead of 1; it gains a +1 to critical range.

e269.name: Maximum: Omniscient Reader’s Viewpoint
e269.text: You have gained the ability to not only see, but also manipulate the contents of your manga panel. At the beginning of your turn, you can choose a creature that you can see that is marked by 6 seconds and roll a d20. Record the roll. As a reaction, you can replace one roll that creature makes with the result of that roll. At the beginning of your turn, you lose any unused rolls.

e270.name: Quick Pose
e270.text: You have learned to activate your technique in a fraction of a second. When you use Golden Hour, you can instead use it as a free action on your turn instead of as a bonus action. As a reaction for 5 CE, you can stop time for yourself and immediately take one turn. After time resumes, your movement is 0 ft and you cannot take actions until the end of your next turn. At 6th level, you can use Golden Week as a bonus action instead of an action.

e270.name: Prime Time
e270.text: Instead of making your technique last longer, you can increase the intensity to create an even sharper burst. When you use Majestic Pose, you can spend an additional 3 cursed energy to instead quadruple your movement speed and gain a +5 bonus to attack rolls within stopped time. However, once time resumes you are unable to move or take actions until the end of your next turn, as a wave of lethargy sweeps over you.

e270.name: Maximum: Clock Hand
e270.text: As a bonus action, you can spend 5 CE to summon the Clock Hand to your hands for 10 minutes. The Clock Hand counts as a Simple Melee weapon that you are proficient with and has the finesse and reach property. It deals 1d10 piercing damage on a hit and has the Hour Hand and Minute Hand properties. Hour Hand: if used against a creature in stopped time, the Clock Hand deals an additional 3d8 necrotic damage on a hit. Minute Hand: if used against a creature not in stopped time, on a hit the creature must make a Cursed Energy save or be frozen in time and suffer the penalties of stopped time until the end of their next turn.

e271.name: Scorpion Tactics
e271.text: You have trained with your hair and unlocked the following maneuvers. Barbed Defense: as a reaction to being targeted by an attack, you can make a Scorpion Hair attack against the attacker if they are within range. Hair Wrapping: on a hit with your Scorpion Hair, you can choose to deal no damage and instead grapple the creature; you can use your Cursed Energy modifier to make grapple checks with your hair. Split Ends: once per turn, when you hit with your Scorpion Hair, you can add your Cursed Energy modifier to the damage roll.

e271.name: Mega-Drill
e271.text: You can now use more cursed energy to imbue one Mega-drill. As an action for 4 cursed energy, you can shoot this Mega-drill in a 5 ft wide, 80 ft long line. Creatures in this line must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it deals 6d10 piercing damage. On a success, they take half the damage. This technique deals maximum damage to objects and structures and ignores half and three quarters cover. The damage of this technique increases to 8d10 at 6th level and becomes 10d10 at 11th level.

e271.name: Air Bomber
e271.text: You have learned the following destructive ways to amplify your Aircraft Hair forms. Copter Frenzy: as an action for 5 CE, you force all creatures within 15 ft to make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save they take your Helicopter Hair damage. On a successful save, they take half as much. Jet Crash: the damage a creature takes from impacting a solid surface from your crash increases to 1d6 per 10 ft traveled in a straight line before hitting the creature. This becomes 1d8 at 11th level and 1d10 at 18th level.

e272.name: Extreme Inverse
e272.text: You have fully mastered your Inverse technique, allowing you to withstand devastating attacks while weak strikes take a heavy toll. When you take damage, the effect depends on whether it exceeds or falls below your threshold. If the damage exceeds your threshold, you reduce it by an amount equal to your level. However, if the damage is below your threshold, you increase the damage taken by an amount equal to your level. This makes you near-invulnerable to powerful blows, but even the lightest strike can prove perilous.

e272.name: Inverted Field
e272.text: While training on your technique, you have found out you have a lot more to offer than just being an indestructible powerhouse. You have learned how to alter a whole area to be affected by your technique. As a bonus action for 6 cursed energy, you cause all objects and creatures within 30 ft of you to be affected by your Inverse technique for 1 minute. A creature or object is no longer affected by Inverse if they leave the range of the field. You can deactivate this as a bonus action.

e272.name: Maximum: Antithesis
e272.text: You’ve learned to channel your inverted energy outward, inverting the flow of harm itself while your Inverse is active: when you take damage within your threshold, you can spend 4 CE as a reaction to reflect half of that damage back to the attacker (damage becomes force or necrotic, your choice) if they are within 30 ft. When you take damage below your threshold, you can instead spend 1 CE as a free action to transfer the pain. Choose a creature within 30 ft to take force or necrotic damage (your choice) equal to twice your CE modifier.

e273.name: Combat IQ
e273.text: Through refining your ability, you have become more skilled in using your technique in combat and can add your Intelligence modifier to Initiative rolls. Additionally, when using Demonic Intellect, you gain the following additional benefits: you add your proficiency bonus to all saving throws you make; you gain an additional reaction each round; once per round you can add your Intelligence modifier to a damage roll you make.

e273.name: Hyper-Intellect
e273.prereq: Prerequisite: Must have Future and Past
e273.text: Your brain has begun to acclimate to the constant amount of information being calculated. Your Intelligence score increases by 3 and you gain proficiency in either History, Investigation, Arcana, Religion, or Nature. Your Intelligence score increases by 1 again at 6th, 11th, and 18th level. Your maximum score for Intelligence is now 24.

e273.name: Calculate Scenario
